headline: Jamie Foxx's annual Halloween festival draws police attention after assaults
subheadline: Police reveals new details about altercations at Jamie Foxx'x Halloween party
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Jamie Foxx’s annual Halloween festival is facing police scrutiny.

The police, after three separate alleged assaults left multiple people injured, with investigators now asking partygoers to share any videos they may have captured.

The Ventura County Sheriff’s Office said the incidents happened on November 7 at the Hidden Valley event, which reportedly attracted at least 3,000 guests.

Read More: Jamie Foxx breaks silence on near-death experience

Two 17-year-old boys from Simi Valley have been identified as suspects, while the victims include two teenagers and a 20-year-old man.

One altercation initially raised concerns about a knife attack after a teenage boy suffered a superficial cut.

However, detectives later determined the injury “appears to be from a mutual combat /simple battery” rather than an assault with a deadly weapon. One suspect was booked at the Ventura County Juvenile Justice Center.

In a separate incident, deputies witnessed a juvenile kicking someone in the head and took the suspect into custody.

The third case involved a man allegedly being punched and kicked during a mosh pit near the concert stage.

He reportedly lost consciousness and later told police his phone and money had gone missing. His phone was eventually recovered from the festival’s lost and found.

Now, detectives are “seeking assistance from anyone who may have captured video footage of these incidents using a cellular phone or other recording device.”

The festival, known as Skvlk Fest, was organized by Foxx’s daughter Anelise and featured performances by Tyga, Ty Dolla $ign, Sexyy Red and Leon Thomas.

Read More: Jamie Foxx's baby news comes with hilarious Al Pacino joke

Last year’s event also made headlines after a glass bottle was thrown at rapper GloRilla during her performance.

headline: Prince William issues powerful statement after women in pain speak out
subheadline: Future King William talks about his secret mission, and it is linked to Duchess Sophie
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince William opened up about his secret mission, which is to work on creating a better working environment for women in the military.

The Prince of Wales has been playing the role of guest editor for a special edition of Country Life magazine that will be published on Wednesday.

William personally commissioned an article about the difficulties faced by women in the forces. The future King shared that he has been conducting secret talks with servicewomen of all ranks from the Royal Navy, RAF and Army to dig deep and hear those in pain.

READ MORE: Prince William reaches major milestone with global impact of his mission

He said, "We need to ensure our military culture is more inclusive of women.

"I want to play my part in making the military feel like the welcoming, open and professional place I enjoyed and make it feel like that for everyone.

"At the moment, I don’t feel that we meet those standards and, as a former serving officer, I really mind it when those who wear the uniform now don’t feel safe, respected or valued."

The article revolved around the Prince of Wales' meetings with servicewomen over the past year.

READ MORE: Prince William, Princess Kate decline to react to Harry, Meghan stunt

"Servicewomen have told him about inappropriate comments, rumours being spread about those who turn down advances, late-night intoxicated harassment in barracks and, most worryingly, from one junior female, about women being used as commodities," it reads.

headline: PM Shehbaz arrives in Turkiye to attend COP31 summit
subheadline: Prime minister scheduled to address COP31 Leaders' Summit tomorrow, says Foreign Office
author: Web Desk
article_text:
PM to stress global measures to combat climate change: FO.
Premier to hold bilateral meetings with Turkish leadership: FO.
PM to attend roundtable convened by COP31 presidency: FO.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Antalya, Turkiye, on Tuesday to attend the Leaders' Summit of the 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), the PM Office said.

Upon arrival, the premier was received by Turkiye's Deputy Minister of Culture and Tourism Gokhan Yazgi, Pakistan’s Ambassador-designate to Turkiye Amna Baloch, and senior Turkish officials.

Information Minister Attaullah Tarar, Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) leader Senator Sherry Rehman and PM's Adviser, Tariq Fatemi, are also accompanying the premier, the PMO said in a statement.

The prime minister, during his November 10-12 visit, is scheduled to address the Leaders' Summit on November 11 and call on the global community to take practical measures to combat climate change, the FO had said in an earlier statement.

According to the FO, PM Shehbaz will highlight Pakistan's steps towards rapid solarisation and expansion of its renewable energy capacity, as part of its transition towards a cleaner and more resilient economy, along with its efforts to strengthen disaster preparedness and early-warning systems.

The prime minister will also call for predictable, adequate and accessible climate finance for developing countries to strengthen their resilience and pursue sustainable development, the FO said.

During the visit, PM Shehbaz will also attend a high-level roundtable convened by the presidency of the COP31 on the sidelines of the Leaders' Summit, and hold bilateral meetings with the Turkish leadership as well as several other world leaders.

"Prime Minister's participation in the COP31 Leaders' Summit is an expression of Pakistan's strong support for the climate agenda, and will provide Pakistan with an opportunity to reaffirm its commitment towards working closely with the international community to address the climate crisis," the FO said.

The COP31 climate talks kicked off Monday with an early fight over money as the UN's chief urged world leaders to "get serious" about tackling the crisis after a year of devastating weather extremes.

Antonio Guterres made his plea as thousands of participants descended on a sprawling expo centre in the Turkish Mediterranean city of Antalya for the UN's annual two-week climate conference.

The summit comes after a year of punishing heatwaves in Europe, major wildfires in Indonesia and catastrophic floods in Nepal, with an exceptionally strong El Nino weather phenomenon fuelling more climate chaos.

Observers expect few major breakthroughs at COP31 as countries grapple with an oil price shock and geopolitical tensions fuelled by the US war with Iran and Russia's conflict in Ukraine.

— With additional input from AFP

The summit comes after a year of punishing heatwaves in Europe, major wildfires in Indonesia and catastrophic floods in Nepal, with an exceptionally strong El Nino weather phenomenon fuelling more climate chaos.

Observers expect few major breakthroughs at COP31 as countries grapple with an oil price shock and geopolitical tensions fuelled by the US war with Iran and Russia's conflict in Ukraine.

Information Minister Attaullah Tarar, Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) leader Senator Sherry Rehman and PM's Adviser, Tariq Fatemi, are also accompanying the premier, the PMO said in a statement.

The prime minister, during his November 10-12 visit, is scheduled to address the Leaders' Summit on November 11 and call on the global community to take practical measures to combat climate change, the FO had said in an earlier statement.

headline: Meghan's mother Doria makes key request to FBI after Thomas Sr arrest
subheadline: Meghan Markle's mother takes bold step to protect daughter after Thomas Markle Sr gets charged for paedophilia
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Meghan Markle, who is travelling to Belgium with her husband Prince Harry for an important engagement, is understood to be in “deep distress” following the arrest of her estranged father.

Thomas Markle Sr was wheeled out by the FBI on Friday and charged on one count of possession of child pornographic material.

It was reported that Meghan’s mother Doria Ragland had assisted the FBI in identifying her ex-husband in the images that were found.

READ MORE: Meghan Markle makes emotional last-minute change to Brussels event

However, she made a special request to the feds about her daughter in light of the recent revelations that have emerged.

“There’s no doubt the material she had to view had turned her world upside down, but she wants Meghan to stay away while she processes the shock,” sources told New Idea.

“Doria’s only request in cooperating was to try and protect Meghan, who’s willing to cooperate with the FBI if needed.”

Doria and Thomas Sr ended their marriage in 1987, six years after Meghan was born.

Meanwhile, she is doing everything in her power to support her daughter during this tough time.

“Meghan knows her mum’s protecting her and it’s like a dark cloud of ugliness has entered her picture-perfect world,” an insider told the outlet.

“She and Doria speak several times a day so she’s cottoned on to how difficult this has been for her mum. She’s worried for her, but Doria is insisting she stay away and focus on her only two grandkids. Archie and Lilibet are the future. Thomas Markle is the past.”

This update comes after source revealed to The Telegraph that Meghan will not be giving a speech in Brussels as originally planned. She is “not strong enough, emotionally, to be doing any public speaking right now”.

headline: Rachel Zegler, Bradley Jaden make it official at Broadway debut
subheadline: Rachel Zegler has a new leading man! The 'Snow White' star goes public with Bradley Jaden
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Looks like Rachel Zegler has found someone worth sharing the spotlight with. The Snow White star appears to have a new romance in her life, and the big reveal came with a touch of Broadway glamour.

On Sunday, November 8, she stepped out to support British actor Bradley Jaden at the opening night of his new musical, Wanted, and the two certainly gave onlookers plenty to talk about.

The pair looked particularly affectionate at the after-party, where The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes actress reportedly introduced Jaden to guests as her boyfriend, according to a source cited by Page Six.

READ MORE: Rachel Zegler anticipates 'Biggest Year' of her life with gratitude

Their appearance marks a noticeable shift from the dating speculation that began in September, when the two were photographed holding hands during a stroll through New York's West Village.

The West Side Story actress also made sure to show her support online. Sharing a video of Jaden taking his opening-night bow on Instagram Stories, she accompanied it with the sweet message, "You are everything," alongside three heart emojis.

Jaden, 39, is making his Broadway debut in Wanted, following an impressive theatre career that includes performances in Les Misérables, Wicked and Camelot.

He also earned attention for his portrayal of Javert in Les Misérables: The Arena Concert Spectacular, gaining the rather memorable fan nickname "Hot Javert."

Zegler, 25, meanwhile, has plenty of theatrical excitement of her own. Following her acclaimed West End run as Eva Perón in Evita, she is preparing to bring the production to Broadway next February.

headline: Stephen Curry rocks Jordan Poole's sunglasses, sinks 3-pointer in viral moment
subheadline: Curry finished with 25 points, contributing to the Warriors' blowout 138-87 win over the Pelicans on Monday night
author: Web Desk
article_text:
During pregame warmups ahead of the Golden State Warriors' Monday night matchup against the New Orleans Pelicans, a video of Stephen Curry trying on Jordan Poole's athletic shades went viral.

Poole was drafted by the Warriors with the 28th overall pick in the 2019 Draft and contributed to the team’s championship title in 2022.

While arming up pregame, Poole, wearing a pair of athletic shades, in a viral moment turned up to his former backcourt mate, Stephen Curry.

The viral moment came when Poole had just finished his shootaround and was headed back to the locker room when Curry was also warming up on the court.

The two stars came close and exchanged their iconic handshake; at that time, Poole’s shades didn’t go unnoticed by Curry.

He asked to try them on and Poole took the shades off and handed them over to Curry to wear for himself.

Curry grabbed and attempted a 3-pointer while shades were on.

Curry finished the night with 25 points, while Yacel Lendeborg scored 23 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists which led to the Warriors their eighth win in a row for a 138-87 blowout win against the Pelicans.

The victory marked the Warriors’ fourth-largest win in franchise history, and the Pelicans’ largest loss in team history.

The victory marked the Warriors’ fourth-largest win in franchise history, and the Pelicans’ largest loss in team history.

headline: Kristen Bell's husband Dax Shepard addresses 'terrible man' narrative
subheadline: Dax Shepard reveals why criticism of his marriage to Kristen Bell hurts
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Dax Shepard is tired of hearing strangers define his marriage to Kristen Bell — and says the accusations being thrown his way have become increasingly difficult to ignore.

On the recent episode of his Armchair Expert podcast, the 51-year-old actor addressed claims that he is controlling and abusive toward his wife of 13 years.

While he initially tried to avoid the latest wave of criticism, he said it became harder when the backlash began affecting Bell.

Read More: Dax Shepard reveals biggest challenge in marriage to Kristen Bell

“Another round of me being a terrible person was in the media, and I avoided that,” he said. “But then it hit Kristen’s doorstep really hard, and then I got to find out everything that people are saying about me.”

Shepard called the accusations “deeply insulting” and said he has spent his life trying not to repeat the behaviour of abusive men he grew up around.

“I don’t ever yell at my children. I don’t yell at my wife,” he said. “To have given it my all to be the opposite of what now some group of people is saying I am, it’s hard.”

He also cleared up a recent comment from Bell about his unusual way of flirting.

The actress had explained that Shepard makes her feel special by complimenting other people — but he insisted there was no secret romance with attractive waitstaff involved.

“I’m finding the dude that I don’t think’s had a compliment in a while and tell him I love his shows. It’s always somebody that I want to make their day.”

Still, the ongoing criticism has started getting to him. Shepard admitted the repeated accusations make him wonder, “Oh, is this now my f---ing role?”

Read More: Dax Shepard denies being 'controlling' and 'abusive'

headline: Trump nominates Natalie Baker as next US ambassador to Pakistan
subheadline: Baker is currently serving as the permanent Chargé d’Affaires to Pakistan
author: Web Desk
article_text:
White House sends nomination to Senate for approval.
Baker joined US embassy as deputy chief in 2024.
Donald Blome was last US ambassador to Pakistan.

US President Donald Trump has nominated diplomat Natalie A Baker as the next US ambassador to Pakistan, with her appointment now awaiting Senate confirmation, according to a White House announcement.

“Natalie Baker, of Texas, a career member of the Senior Foreign Service, Class of Minister-Counsellor, to be Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of the United States of America to the Islamic Republic of Pakistan,” the White House said.

The US government has sent her nomination to the Senate for approval.

Baker is currently serving as the permanent Chargé d’Affaires to Pakistan. She assumed the duties of Chargé d’Affaires ad interim at the embassy in January 2025 before being given the permanent charge last month.

Baker’s nomination comes amid ongoing diplomatic engagement between Washington and Islamabad on trade, investment, security and regional matters.

Donald Blome was the last US ambassador to Pakistan before leaving the post in January 2025.

Before arriving in Islamabad, Baker served as Deputy Chief of Mission at the US embassy in Doha, Qatar, from August 2021 to July 2024. Prior to that, she was Director of the Office of North African Affairs in the State Department's Near Eastern Affairs Bureau.

Her previous assignments include serving as Deputy Chief of Mission and Chargé d’Affaires at the US Mission to Libya, Deputy Director of the Iran Regional Presence Office at the US Consulate in Dubai, and Economic Counsellor at the US embassy in Kuwait.

From 2009 to 2011, Baker served as Political and Economic Counsellor in Libya during the normalisation of bilateral relations. She remained in the country until the 2011 Libyan Revolution forced the evacuation of the embassy.

Her other assignments include serving as Special Assistant in the Bureau of Near Eastern Affairs, Consular Officer in Islamabad, and Cultural Affairs Officer in Ashgabat, Turkmenistan.

Baker holds a bachelor's degree from Princeton University and a master's degree in public policy from the Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University. She was a Distinguished Graduate of the National War College at the National Defence University in 2017 and speaks Arabic, Spanish, Farsi and Russian.

headline: Prince Harry turns Meghan's pillar of strength in first outing amid crisis
subheadline: Meghan Markle puts on brave face in first appearance since Thomas Markle's arrest
author: Areeba Khan
article_text:
Prince Harry tightly held Meghan Markle's hand at his first public appearance since the arrest of Thomas Markle.

The couple arrived hand in hand at the European Parliament in Brussels to carry out a key task.

At first, it was reported that Harry and Meghan would both deliver speeches related to creating a safe online space for children.

However, after 'child pornography' allegations against Thomas Markle emerged, Meghan stepped back, reportedly because she is not "emotionally strong enough" to do any public speaking.

READ MORE: Meghan Markle's father alarming confession sends shockwaves

As seen in the video shared by journalist Chris Ship, Harry became a pillar of support for his beloved wife during a family crisis.

The Duke and Duchess of Sussex are meeting European lawmakers as part of their Screen Memorial campaign for grieving families whose children have died as a result of harm caused by social media.

It is important to mention that Thomas Markle was arrested in Florida on Friday. He has been charged with possession of child sex abuse images.

Earlier, Meghan strongly condemned her father's actions and finally revealed that this was the reason for keeping Archie and Lilibet at a distance from him.

READ MORE: Meghan Markle 'responds' to father Thomas Markle 'appalling' act

She also expressed solidarity with the innocent children and their families.

headline: USDA issues health alert for 3 frozen meat, poultry products: details inside
subheadline: The items may have been sold at a festival and farmers market in Greer, South Carolina, FSIS reported
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The U.S. Department of Agriculture has issued a 'do-not-eat' health alert for frozen meats sold online across America, according to a Food Safety and Inspection Service notice dated November 6, 2026.

The beef, and poultry products were made by Betterballen Foods LLC, a U.S.-based manufacturer of authentic Dutch foods, and may be mislabelled, per the Safety alert.

The items were sold by Lowlands House for online sales.

The items may have been sold at a festival and farmers market in Greer, South Carolina, FSIS reported.

The frozen meat and poultry products were produced on October 15, October 16, and October 27, 2026, and contain the establishment number “EST. M3177” or “EST. P3177” inside the USDA mark of inspection.

A recall was not initiated because the products are no longer available for purchase.

However, the USDA’s food safety agency has warned that the products which are supposed to be stored in consumers’ fridges could trigger a serious reaction if someone with allergies consumes them.

Anyone concerned about an illness or injury linked to the product is advised to contact a doctor immediately.

headline: Scotland suspends cricket ties with Afghanistan over Taliban regime's treatment of women
subheadline: Cricket Scotland says it will not schedule matches against Afghanistan outside International Cricket Council events
author: Reuters
article_text:
Cricket Scotland said it would not schedule matches against Afghanistan outside International Cricket Council (ICC) events, citing concerns over the treatment of women and girls under the Taliban government and broader human rights issues.

Women's sport has effectively disappeared in Afghanistan since the Afghan Taliban returned to power in 2021, while access to education and employment opportunities for women has been severely curtailed.

The Taliban regime says they respect women's rights in accordance with their interpretation of religious law and local customs and that internal matters should be addressed locally.

Scotland's move aligns with decisions by Cricket Australia and the England and Wales Cricket Board to suspend bilateral ties with Afghanistan, which the ICC made a Full Member in 2017.

"This policy will be kept under review annually or following any significant ICC decision or material change in circumstances," Cricket Scotland said on Monday.

It added that its decision was based on its commitment to growing women's and girls' participation in the sport, as well as the humanitarian situation in Afghanistan.

Reuters has contacted the Afghanistan Cricket Board (ACB) for comment.

Scotland have not faced Afghanistan in a full international match since the 2021 Twenty20 World Cup, but the governing body said the ACB had requested training facilities in July ahead of their men's series against Ireland.

The ACB had made another request for training facilities in Scotland in September regarding the T20 Afghanistan Premier League, it added.

Cricket Scotland also said it would continue to consider its contractual obligations to players and would issue no-objection certificates (NOCs) if the ICC gives the Afghan league official approval.

"If an NOC is issued, participation by that player/s must not be interpreted as an endorsement by Cricket Scotland of the current Afghan regime or its policies," the statement said.

headline: Hidden tension between Martha Stewart, Craig Melvin laid bare over Halloween
subheadline: Martha Stewart reportedly pressured to apologise after Halloween coctume fiasco
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Martha Stewart may have smiled through her apology to Craig Melvin on TODAY, but a new report suggests the moment was far less cheerful behind the scenes.

According to sources speaking to Rob Shutter, the lifestyle mogul was allegedly given a choice: apologize to Melvin or risk losing her planned Thanksgiving appearance on the NBC morning show.

The tension reportedly began after Stewart’s Halloween costume — in which she portrayed a homeless person holding a sign asking for food — triggered backlash.

Read More: Martha Stewart in hot water after Craig Melvin's Halloween dress explanation

Her attempt to explain the outfit by bringing Melvin into the conversation reportedly made matters worse among TODAY staff.

“Martha was told she had to apologize. This wasn’t optional. She was facing the possibility of losing her Thanksgiving segment, and nobody wanted this controversy hanging over the show. She did it through gritted teeth, but she knew she had no choice,” an NBC insider shared.

One staffer reportedly felt Melvin had been unfairly dragged into the controversy.

“Blaming a Black man for your own bad judgment is tone-deaf. People inside NBC couldn’t understand why she thought making Craig part of the story was a good idea. He didn’t deserve to be put in that position,” the staffer told the outlet.

The report also claims Savannah Guthrie’s absence during the apology raised questions, while frustration among employees remains.

Read More: Martha Stewart's Halloween controversy takes another turn

“Craig accepted the apology because that’s who he is. But don’t confuse his graciousness with everyone else being over it. Staff are still angry, and Martha knows she damaged her standing,” another insider said.

headline: Starc denies knowledge of ball-tampering plot, Cricket Australia rules out new probe
subheadline: CA boss says players have different views from those of Usman Khawaja
author: Reuters
article_text:
Fast bowler Mitchell Starc denied on Tuesday any prior knowledge of Australia's plot to tamper with the ball during the 2018 tour of South Africa, as Cricket Australia boss Todd Greenberg ruled out another investigation into 'Sandpapergate'.

Starc is the first of Australia's bowlers to respond to Usman Khawaja's assertions in his autobiography and on social media that the whole team knew of a plan to manipulate the ball in order to get it to reverse swing.

Starc reiterated the bowlers' position from a 2021 statement that they did not know a "foreign substance" had been taken onto the field to alter the condition of the ball.

“I haven’t really paid much attention to be fair, obviously there’s differing opinions of eight years ago," Starc told reporters in Sydney on Tuesday.

"We were heavily drilled through the process at the time, and since and I guess I won’t speak on behalf of the bowlers, but where I stand, my opinion hasn’t changed. My recollection hasn’t changed from what we said in 2021."

The scandal triggered an integrity probe by Cricket Australia (CA) and led to bans and other penalties for then-captain Steve Smith and former test openers David Warner and Cameron Bancroft four days after the incident came to light during the Cape Town Test.

Khawaja said the team began tampering with the ball at the second test against South Africa in Gqeberha, not in the third at Cape Town, where they were caught.

Starc said Khawaja's account was the first time he was aware of ball-tampering taking place in Gqeberha.

"I'll leave said authors to explain," he said.

Warner, who retired from international cricket more than two years ago, broke his silence about the scandal on Monday to throw his support behind Khawaja.

In a video posted on social media, Warner described his former teammate's account as 100% accurate and the CA investigation as "botched" and "rushed".

'Very different views'

Media pundits, including former captain Michael Clarke, have demanded CA re-investigate the case.

However, Greenberg told local radio station SEN on Tuesday there was "no compelling reason" to reopen the investigation and could not see anything to be gained from it.

He said players had "very different views" from Khawaja's version of events.

"There are specific details in his book that contradict the versions that have been provided by others," he said.

"But we have said we’re comfortable with the outcome of the investigation based on the information we’ve received.

"That includes what we’ve seen from Usman, and our position hasn’t changed on that."

Former Cricket Australia CEO James Sutherland, who was in charge of the governing body during the incident, declined to comment on Tuesday.

Bancroft, who played his last international in 2019, declined to comment to Australian media on Monday.

He said in a 2021 interview with the Guardian that it was "self-explanatory" that teammates apart from Smith and Warner were aware of the ball-tampering plan.

Captain Pat Cummins said in South Africa last month that he had spoken to Khawaja before the release of the autobiography and was not concerned about any potential fallout.

"Answered every question a million times. So, yeah, it was dealt with then," he said.

Some commentators have questioned why Khawaja waited eight years to speak out and accused him of trying to boost sales of his book "Sabr".

Khawaja responded on social media on Tuesday, saying he had no commercial motives.

"I'm very fortunate, I don't need the money," he said.

article_html:
Fast bowler Mitchell Starc denied on Tuesday any prior knowledge of Australia's plot to tamper with the ball during the 2018 tour of South Africa, as Cricket Australia boss Todd Greenberg ruled out another investigation into 'Sandpapergate'.

Starc is the first of Australia's bowlers to respond to Usman Khawaja's assertions in his autobiography and on social media that the whole team knew of a plan to manipulate the ball in order to get it to reverse swing.

Starc reiterated the bowlers' position from a 2021 statement that they did not know a "foreign substance" had been taken onto the field to alter the condition of the ball.

“I haven’t really paid much attention to be fair, obviously there’s differing opinions of eight years ago," Starc told reporters in Sydney on Tuesday.

"We were heavily drilled through the process at the time, and since and I guess I won’t speak on behalf of the bowlers, but where I stand, my opinion hasn’t changed. My recollection hasn’t changed from what we said in 2021."

The scandal triggered an integrity probe by Cricket Australia (CA) and led to bans and other penalties for then-captain Steve Smith and former test openers David Warner and Cameron Bancroft four days after the incident came to light during the Cape Town Test.

Khawaja said the team began tampering with the ball at the second test against South Africa in Gqeberha, not in the third at Cape Town, where they were caught.

Starc said Khawaja's account was the first time he was aware of ball-tampering taking place in Gqeberha.

"I'll leave said authors to explain," he said.

Warner, who retired from international cricket more than two years ago, broke his silence about the scandal on Monday to throw his support behind Khawaja.

In a video posted on social media, Warner described his former teammate's account as 100% accurate and the CA investigation as "botched" and "rushed".

'Very different views'

Media pundits, including former captain Michael Clarke, have demanded CA re-investigate the case.

However, Greenberg told local radio station SEN on Tuesday there was "no compelling reason" to reopen the investigation and could not see anything to be gained from it.

He said players had "very different views" from Khawaja's version of events.

"There are specific details in his book that contradict the versions that have been provided by others," he said.

"But we have said we’re comfortable with the outcome of the investigation based on the information we’ve received.

"That includes what we’ve seen from Usman, and our position hasn’t changed on that."

Former Cricket Australia CEO James Sutherland, who was in charge of the governing body during the incident, declined to comment on Tuesday.

Bancroft, who played his last international in 2019, declined to comment to Australian media on Monday.

He said in a 2021 interview with the Guardian that it was "self-explanatory" that teammates apart from Smith and Warner were aware of the ball-tampering plan.

Captain Pat Cummins said in South Africa last month that he had spoken to Khawaja before the release of the autobiography and was not concerned about any potential fallout.

"Answered every question a million times. So, yeah, it was dealt with then," he said.

Some commentators have questioned why Khawaja waited eight years to speak out and accused him of trying to boost sales of his book "Sabr".

Khawaja responded on social media on Tuesday, saying he had no commercial motives.

"I'm very fortunate, I don't need the money," he said.

headline: Meghan Markle reacts to reporters asking about father's arrest
subheadline: Prince Harry, Meghan Markle break cover for the first time following Thomas Markle Sr arrest
author: A. Akmal
article_text:
Prince Harry and Meghan Markle arrived in Brussels at the European Parliament on Tuesday, in what is their first appearance since the Thomas Markle Sr arrest.

The couple, both dressed in black and wearing poppy pins for Remembrance Day, appeared in good spirits, but it was clear Meghan was holding firm onto her husband for support.

As they stepped inside the building, Harry and Meghan were seen engaged in conversation with the people, assumed to be the organisers.

READ MORE: Meghan Markle makes emotional last-minute change to Brussels event

However, as the reporters asked them about the Thomas Sr situation, the couple clearly ignored the questions and moved ahead.

“Meghan, how are you feeling and how are you coping?” one reporter was heard asking.

Another asked, “Meghan, Harry, any comment on the situation?”

However, neither of them stopped to acknowledge them and kept walking straight ahead.

The Sussexes are in Brussels open their Lost Screen Memorial at the parliament. Initially they were both set to give an address but a spokesperson for the Duchess of Sussex revealed a change in programme.

Prince Harry would be delivering the keynote speech solo as “just not strong enough, emotionally, to be doing any public speaking right now”.

READ MORE: Meghan Markle's father alarming confession sends shockwaves

Meghan has reportedly been under “deep distress” as her estranged father has been charged with possession of child abuse material after he was arrest by the FBI on Friday.

The mum of Archie and Lilibet has previously expressed her grievances for the victims affected in this incident and hopes justice is served.

headline: Ross Lynch deletes ex Jaz Sinclair's photos after fan's nudge
subheadline: Newly married Ross Lynch responds to fan who spots ex-girlfriend's photos on his social media
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Ross Lynch has some explaining to do after fan spotted ex girlfriend Jaz Sinclair photos on his social media following the secret marriage reveal.

The singer and actor found himself at the centre of an unexpected social media moment after a TikTok user pointed out that he still had photographs of Sinclair on his Instagram despite recently revealing that he was married.

Apparently, the 30-year-old actor didn't appear to be aware that the old pictures were still sitting on his profile.

READ MORE: Ross Lynch shocks fans with 'married man' status after long hiatus

Responding directly to the fan's TikTok, he wrote, "I had no idea. Thanks for the heads up. I deleted them."

As if that wasn't enough to get people talking, the Austin & Ally alum followed up with another comment, adding: "Also not a 'maga'."

For the unversed, Lynch, 30, recently surprised fans by revealing that he had secretly tied the knot.

He confirmed his marital status on November 5, while attending the New York premiere of his upcoming Netflix film Heartland.

Sporting a gold wedding band, the former Disney Channel star told PEOPLE, "Yes, yes I am," when asked whether he was married.

Interestingly, eagle-eyed followers had already spotted the ring in his June Instagram comeback post, shared after almost a year away from the platform.

As for his new wife, Lynch has chosen to keep her identity and wedding date private, explaining that she isn't particularly fond of celebrity attention and that he wants to respect her privacy.

Meanwhile, his history with Sinclair goes back to their time on Netflix's Chilling Adventures of Sabrina.

The two met while playing Harvey Kinkle and Rosalind Walker, respectively, and their off-screen friendship eventually blossomed into romance.

They were romantically linked from around 2018 until their reported split in 2023, becoming a favourite couple among fans of the series.

headline: 'Stubborn' William, Harry sad truth: They don't need each other anymore
subheadline: Prince William and Prince Harry have no more thurst to repair their fractured relaionship
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince William and Prince Harry's once an unbreakable brotherhood has been pushed by a bitter feud past the point of no return, according to a new claim.

King Charles' two sons have seemnigly found their replacements and have no more thurst to repair their fractured relaionship. It is a painful truth that even the strongest bonds can break when pride and ego speak louder than love and respect.

The recent developments suggest "Reconciliation is not in the cards."

READ MORE: Princess Kate spares no mercy for Meghan Markle despite distressing ordeal

Christopher Andersen said, "It shouldn't come as any surprise that William views Harry as having betrayed not only the royal family but the institution of the monarchy itself," adding: "Harry's return to the UK just rubbed salt into an already festering wound."

"These are two extraordinarily strong and stubborn men who have, sadly, learned over the past few years that they can live without each other," Andersen told Fox News Digital.

The latest comments and claims come amid reports that the Duke and Duchess of Sussex are not planning to apologise to William and Kate.

Previously, it was reported that the Sussexes may say sorry to the Prince and Princess of Wales over comments they made during their 2021 interview with Oprah Winfrey.

However, a source close to Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet's parents claimed that the report was "nonsense."

Harry has made progress in rebuilding his relationship with his father, King Charles, but there’s no movement, especially on William’s side, according to a new report.

British broadcaster Helena Chard said that William is unlikely to forgive his brother. She noted that teh future British monarch once saw Harry as a supportive "wingman", but now the situation has totally changed.

Chard went on, "The sheer stress and upset caused to his family over the past few years is impossible to forgive."

Defending the Sussexes, royal commentator Meredith Constant believes that the couple have no reason to apologise, adding: "Harry and Meghan overwhelmingly say positive things about William and Kate."

"With that said, I don't think they'd go back and do an hour-plus television interview again," Constant added.

"Meghan calls Kate a 'good person' and admires how she handled the pre-wedding situation when she hurt Meghan's feelings."

Constant said that as the future king, William "should lead and take the first step towards reconciliation. But, as Harry said, 'reconciliation requires accountability.'"

"And how can William or Kate take accountability for a problem that they, and the rest of the royal family, wouldn't even acknowledge exists?"

headline: 'Why sit as ministers?': CM Maryam hits back at critics amid corruption allegations
subheadline: Punjab chief executive vows action against any minister if evidence of corruption is presented
author: Web Desk
article_text:
CM Maryam says she never claimed corruption eliminated in Punjab.
Only chief minister who is regularly uncovering corruption: Maryam.
Questions whether corruption did not exist in Sindh, KP, Balochistan.

Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz has challenged critics of her government over corruption allegations, questioning why "dissatisfied" ministers continue holding office instead of resigning.

"Those who have a problem should resign. Why are they sitting there as ministers?" the provincial chief executive said while addressing an event in Jhelum on Tuesday.

Her remarks come after federal minister and Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz's (PML-N) political ally Chaudhry Salik Hussain of PML-Q MNA alleged corruption in Punjab.

In an interview with a private television channel on November 2, Hussain had said he did not possess evidence but heard stories about corruption in Punjab every day.

The Punjab chief minister later sought Rs5 billion in damages from Hussain over his allegations, according to a legal notice served on the minister.

The six-page notice, issued on CM Maryam's behalf by Additional Advocate General Punjab Chaudhry Muhammad Nawaz, maintained that Hussain had failed to identify any document, official inquiry, audit observation, investigation, complaint or other verifiable source to substantiate his remarks.

Meanwhile, the provincial chief executive said that people who had not delivered anything in the past found it easy to accuse others of corruption, adding that she had never claimed corruption had been completely eliminated in Punjab.

"I have never said that corruption has been completely eliminated in Punjab."

However, she claimed that Punjab is the only province where the chief minister regularly uncovered corruption cases, questioning whether corruption did not exist in Sindh, Balochistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

She challenged anyone possessing evidence against a member of her cabinet to come forward, saying she would not spare any minister found involved in wrongdoing. "If anyone comes forward with evidence against my minister, I will not spare them."

CM Maryam said that, for the first time, a government was standing alongside poor and working-class people, adding that politically influential individuals could no longer dare to assault common people.

She also described an incident involving a shopkeeper who allegedly assaulted a young girl.

According to the chief minister, she instructed that the girl be brought to the police station and told to slap the wealthy shopkeeper in return.

headline: Kendall Jenner makes surprising confession amid Jacob Elordi romance
subheadline: Kendall Jenner sets the record straight on Cara Delevingne romance rumours
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Kendall Jenner has finally addressed the internet’s long-running theories about her and Cara Delevingne — and she didn’t exactly leave much room for interpretation.

In a new episode of The Kardashians, filmed during a backstage chat at a L’Oréal Paris fashion show, Kendall reflected on her 11-year friendship with Cara and the rumours that the two once had a romantic relationship.

“People think I’m a lesbian to this day,” Kendall said, before making her position clear: “I’m not.”

Read More: Kendall Jenner lands major new role in global campaign

The model, who turns 31 next month, explained that their close bond is likely what keeps the speculation alive. She also admitted she “wouldn’t be opposed to having some fun with a girl.”

When Cara asked which woman she would choose, Kendall simply replied, “Obviously”.

Kendall has pushed back against the rumours before. On the In Your Dreams podcast in January, she said the online speculation bothered her less than the way people discussed it.

“There’s the whole side of the internet that thinks I’m a lesbian… You want to know what really bothers me? How mean people are about it.”

She added that if she were queer, she would have “no problem” being open about it.

The conversation comes as Kendall’s reported romance with actor Jacob Elordi continues to attract attention.

The pair have been linked since earlier this year and were recently spotted together at the Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles.

Read More: Kendall Jenner shares first post after outing with Jacob Elordi

Still, neither has publicly confirmed the relationship — apparently, some things are staying off the internet for now.

headline: Warriors backcourt depth hit by injuries to Brandon Williams, Will Richard amid 8-0 run
subheadline: 'He’s a huge part of our team, and he’s given us such a lift, and it’s a hamstring. He is gonna get an MRI, so we’ll see how bad it is' said Warriors head coach Steve Kerr
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The Warriors are facing injury woes that have hit their backcourt depth hard in the early phase of the NBA 2026-27 NBA season, despite an eight-game winning run.

Golden State Warriors guard Brandon Williams made a brief appearance in the Warriors’ dominant 138-87 win over the New Orleans Pelicans on Monday, November 9, at Chase Centre.

Williams played 1:39 for Golden State and posted 4 points on 2-of-3 shooting attempts before he suffered a hamstring injury.

Williams left the court with 3 minutes and 18 seconds left in the first quarter and did not make a comeback.

Warriors head coach Steve Kerr updated on the Warriors guard who is set to undergo an MRI.

“He’s a huge part of our team, and he’s given us such a lift, and it’s a hamstring,” Kerr told the media postgame, adding, “He is gonna get an MRI, so we’ll see how bad it is.”

If the Warriors' guard has dealt a serious blow with his hamstring injury, chances are the Warriors’ backcourt depth will be in serious trouble.

Besides Williams’ injury, reserve guard Will Richard didn’t appear on Monday night in a matchup against the Pelicans.

Richard who has suffered a torn ulnar collateral ligament (UCL) in his left thumb has been ruled out for an indefinite period.

The Warriors were also without Gary Payton II, who missed the game with an illness and left knee inflammation.

Despite injury woes that have hit their backcourt depth hard, the Warriors remain unbeaten in their last eight games, having handed the Pelicans a 138-87 blowout loss on Monday, November 9, 2026.

headline: BTS Jimin quietly returns to military during 'Arirang World Tour' break
subheadline: BTS fans react to Jimin’s military comeback as eyewitnesses share accounts
author: Web Desk
article_text:
After concluding their South America leg of the Arirang World Tour, the BTS members had returned to South Korea for their down time.

The k-pop band began touring again following their 18-month mandatory military service. However, fans discovered that one of the members had returned to fulfil an important obligation as a “reservist”.

An eyewitness shared that they saw Jimin as he performed CPR drills and exhibited exceptional shooting skills.

READ MORE: BTS shocks fans with new move after Brazil show ‘IDOL' walk gets cancelled

He was also praised for his striking looks and long blonde hair.

“You could do front and back flips, you could even be going faster than a KTX (the speed of Korea’s trains), and you’d still recognise Jimin right away just from his aura,” one comment on X read.

The remarks noted that the Who singer “stood out” in the crowd and had been graceful in his movements when performing the CPR drill.

“According to those who saw him, Jimin was really good at shooting and looked like he was dancing while doing chest compressions. His long hair suited him incredibly well, and he looked so beautiful. Even from a guy’s perspective, reserve soldier Jimin was so cool.”

Fans also took the opportunity to praise Jimin's exceptional performance in the military when he served. Jimin, who was a Sergeant in his division, was recognised as the Special Class Warrior.

It is an elite recognition awarded for high performance in combat skills, physical fitness, and mental resilience.

The Reserve Military training is another mandatory aspect for men, who have completed their active-duty military service. It is drill that they have to once every year to maintain military skills.

The obligation last for nearly five to six years. The former soldiers are expected to undergo intensive training for roughly one to three days.

BTS are expected to resume their tour in Asia from November 21st and head on to Australia before closing out the year. More international dates are to follow in the first half of 2027, which will be announced later.

headline: Robert De Niro's ex Toukie Smith breathes her last at 74
subheadline: Robert De Niro and Toukie Smith's children pay tribute to their late mother
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Toukie Smith, who was the former partner of Robert De Niro, has passed away at the age of 74.

Her twins Airyn De Niro and Julian Henry De Niro confirmed that their mother breathed her last on Wednesday, November 4, after a long battle with multiple sclerosis.

“Toukie was a force of nature,” her children ,whom she share with The Intern star, said in a statement. “She left an indelible mark on our hearts and on everyone lucky enough to know her.”

READ MORE: Ross Lynch deletes ex Jaz Sinclair's photos after fan's nudge

She and De Niro were partners from 1988-96, during which they welcomed twin children, conceived by in vitro fertilization and delivered via surrogate.

Born on September 25, 1952, in Philadelphia, Toukie recurred on Miami Vice before playing Eva Rawley on the NBC sitcom 227.

Her first screen credits was a role on the NBC’s popular cop drama. She played Angie, the assistant to Caitlin Davies (Sheena Easton), an ill-fated pop singer whose bodyguard and eventual husband is Sonny Crockett (Don Johnson).

Toukie appeared in three Season 4 episodes of Miami Vice from 1987 to 88.

She went on to appear in the 1988 feature Me and Him before landing her most famous role. The late actress guested on the Marla Gibbs-led 227 late in its penultimate Season 4 and was promoted to series regular for the final season in 1989-90.

Her Eva Rawley was an artist who becomes the manager of 227 Lexington Place before leaving the job and working at an art gallery. Smith appeared in two dozen episodes of the series.

After 227 wrapped, Smith would have roles in such 1990s features as The Preacher’s Wife, I Like It Like That, Joe’s Apartment and Goosed.

headline: Ariana Grande reveals unusual first meeting with Ben Stiller
subheadline: Ariana Grande and Ben Stiller reunite after their 'Zoolander 2' Orgy scene
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Ariana Grande’s first meeting with Ben Stiller was certainly not the usual Hollywood introduction — and somehow, their reunion managed to get even more awkward.

Appearing alongside Stiller and Robert De Niro on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, the singer was asked about meeting her future Focker-in-Law co-star for the first time.

Her answer immediately sent the audience laughing.

Read More: Ariana Grande breaks hiatus with surprise TV appearance

“He was directing me in an orgy scene in Zoolander 2 with a hippo and Susan Sarandon,” Grande revealed.

The 2016 comedy featured Grande in Hansel’s (Owen Wilson) eccentric romantic circle, so she and Stiller skipped the usual small talk and got straight to the unusual stuff.

“So right off the bat, we had a comfortability,” she joked. Stiller agreed they had an instant connection, prompting Grande to add, “It sounds like two truths and a lie, but it’s my reality.”

Years later, the pair reunited for Focker-in-Law, in which Grande plays Olivia Jones, the strong-willed fiancée of Stiller’s character Greg Focker’s son.

But their first scene together wasn't exactly a relaxed table read. Instead, Grande had to perform the Heimlich manoeuvre on Stiller.

“We were thrust into rehearsing the Heimlich scene, where I give you [Stiller] the Heimlich,” she recalled.

She had expected to discuss their characters and work through the script. Instead, the stunt team got straight to business.

Read More: Ariana Grande reacts to VMAs win from home amid her break from spotlight

“My mom was like, ‘How was your first day, honey?’ I was like, ‘Well, I gave Ben Stiller the Heimlich for a few hours.’ It was crazy.”

Focker-in-Law arrives in theaters on November 25.

ISLAMABAD: The Islamabad High Court (IHC) on Tuesday directed that lawyers Latif Khosa and Salman Safdar be allowed to meet Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) founding chairman Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi, in Adiala jail, with the attorney general saying the meetings could be arranged if they assured the court that arguments in the appeals would begin at the next hearing.

A division bench comprising IHC Chief Justice Sardar Muhammad Sarfraz Dogar and Justice Muhammad Asif issued directives while hearing appeals filed by Imran and Bushra against their convictions in the £190 million case.

An accountability court in Islamabad had earlier sentenced the former prime minister to 14 years' imprisonment with a fine of Rs1 million, while the ex-first lady was awarded seven years' imprisonment along with a fine of Rs500,000.

During the hearing today, lawyer Khosa told the court that he had repeatedly sought a meeting with Imran but had not been allowed to meet him.

To this, the IHC chief justice asked how long Khosa wanted the meeting to last. Khosa requested at least an hour, after which the court directed the Islamabad advocate general to arrange his meeting with Imran and Bushra.

Imran’s counsel, Barrister Salman Safdar, also requested another meeting, saying his previous meeting with the PTI founder had provided instructions but was insufficient. He told the court that he had met Imran after seven months and Bushra Bibi after 11 months.

Safdar said Imran had told him that his eyesight had improved but his blood pressure remained uncontrolled, warning of a risk of brain haemorrhage.

He also expressed concern over Bushra Bibi's eyesight, saying her condition is serious and that she told him she is scheduled to undergo another operation on November 15.

Safdar requested a medical board to examine the former first lady and said her treatment could not be properly carried out in jail. The Islamabad advocate general, however, told the court that she was receiving medical treatment and presented records of the facilities provided to her.

The chief justice said health-related matters were pending before the Federal Constitutional Court (FCC), while Safdar maintained that no matter concerning Bushra was pending there.

During the proceedings, the court also discussed the preparation of paper books for the appeals. Safdar said the documents had not yet been provided to the defence, making it difficult to prepare for arguments.

The IHC CJ granted time for preparation and urged Khosa to begin arguments in the £190m case at the next hearing.

Al-Qadir Trust case

The Al-Qadir Trust case, commonly known as the £190m case, involved allegations that Imran and some others in 2019 adjusted Rs50 billion — amounting to £190 million at the time — sent by Britain's National Crime Agency (NCA) to the Pakistani government during his tenure as the country's prime minister.

The concerned amount relates to a property tycoon's assets, which were seized by the NCA during PTI's rule. The British crime agency back then had said that the amount was supposed to be passed to the Government of Pakistan as its settlement with the Pakistani property tycoon was "a civil matter, and does not represent a finding of guilt".

However, NAB filed a reference in December 2023, followed by charges against Imran and Bushra on February 27, 2024, alleging that a settlement with the British crime agency was reached and approved by then-prime minister Imran on December 3, 2019, without disclosing details of the confidential agreement.

headline: Prince Harry breaks silence on children safety after Thomas Markle arrest
subheadline: 'I'm here as a father. My wife, as a mother': Prince Harry on creating safe spaces for kids
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Prince Harry emphasised creating safe spaces for children following Meghan Markle's father's arrest due to a 'shameful' act.

Thomas Markle has been arrested for possession of child abuse images, leaving the Duchess in mental turmoil, and she stepped back from public speaking.

But her husband, Harry, took charge and delivered an important speech at the European Parliament in Brussels related to creating a safe online space for children.

READ MORE: Prince Harry's new role confirmed in fresh statement after wowing Britons

Archie and Lilibet's father said that every kid "deserves to feel safe wherever they are." Though he did not directly mention the latest allegations against Thomas, Harry's speech appeared to be a reaction to them.

He said, "I’m not here as an expert or a politician. I’m here as a father. My wife, as a mother.

"Why, when we ask whether it can keep a child safe, does everything suddenly become complicated?

"I am not asking for a world without technology.

"That isn’t possible; it isn’t what young people want, and it certainly isn’t what I want for my own children.

"All children should be able to go online and discover something wonderful. A friend. An interest that becomes a passion. A place where they feel understood.

"They deserve to feel safe wherever they are. In a classroom. On a playground. At any time, no matter where they are.

"My approach to life, and to the value of it, has perhaps unsurprisingly always been about prevention.

READ MORE: Prince Harry scores big UK win: 'Royalty not required'

"Preventing harm before it happens, rather than waiting for tragedy before deciding something must change."

headline: Kim Kardashian's business faces backlash over Holiday calendar
subheadline: Kim Karadshian's beauty brand responds to 'scam' claims over its $148 advent calendar
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Kim Kardashian’s SKIMS is giving unhappy customers a way to get their money back after its $148 advent calendar turned into an unexpected holiday headache.

The brand has acknowledged the backlash surrounding its limited-edition accessories calendar and confirmed it is offering refunds or store credit to customers who felt let down by the purchase.

headline: Deion Sanders' son Shilo slams NYC rent prices amid bankruptcy trial
subheadline: 'My biggest thing about New York, bro, is the square footage for the price' Shilo said
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Amid the ongoing bankruptcy trial of $11.89 million, Deion Sanders’ son, Shilo Sanders, has been taking his YouTube community with him, sharing his apartment rent hunting journey through video content.

Sanders has amassed over 324,000 subscribers on YouTube.

In a recent upload, Shilo couldn’t hold back his thoughts on the city’s real estate market as his frustrating house-hunting journey continues.

Shilo posted a video on his YouTube channel this week, where he talks about real estate prices while getting his haircut.

“My biggest thing about New York, bro, is the square footage for the price,” Shilo said.

“Like, even if my budget is, I’m not even gonna say this is my budget, but you can go all the way up to $12,000 a month, and it’s despicable what they’re doing up there, bro,” he continued.

“I don’t know who normalised the real estate market in New York, but it’s outrageous, bro,” Shilo said, going on to slam NYC's real estate market.

The former Colorado Buffaloes player is facing an ongoing $11.89 million bankruptcy trail.

The lawsuit stemmed from an incident in 2015, when John Darjean, a former security guard at Shilo’s school, alleged Shilo caused injuries to Darjean when he tried to seize Shilo’s phone.

Darjean ultimately won a default judgement of $11.89 million after Shilo failed to appear before the court for the 2022 trial.

But, in 2023, Shilo filed for Chapter 7 bankruptcy.

In the case, Judge Michael Romero’s ruling in the bankruptcy case is still pending and may not come until 2027.

While in another lawsuit, Barnes & Thornburg LLP filed a case against Shilo, alleging that there were about $170,000 in unpaid bills.

But the case was dismissed with prejudice back in October.

Sanders, 26, finished his collegiate football career after graduation in 2024.

He was released by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in 2025 after he wasn’t drafted by any NFL franchise in April 2025.

headline: Prince William team shares update amid Harry, Meghan's moving appearance
subheadline: Prince William makes statement as Prince Harry and Meghan Markle take on key role in Brussels
author: A. Akmal
article_text:
Prince William, who is preparing for his upcoming overseas visit for an important cause, shared a key update as Prince Harry and Meghan Markle made a joint appearance in Belgium.

The couple, who stepped out for the first time since the arrest of Thomas Markle Sr, opened the Lost Screen Memorial, which honours children lost due to the harms of social media.

As Prince Harry had been delivering the keynote speech at the European Parliament on Tuesday morning, the Prince of Wales team shared a statement regarding the Earthshot Prize ceremony.

READ MORE: Meghan Markle reacts to reporters asking about father's arrest

“It’s almost time!” it stated. “The Earthshot Prize Awards Night 2026 lands in Mumbai on 17 November.”

It noted that “five of our 15 incredible Finalists will each win £1 million to scale their solutions” and revealed the performers for the evening.

It appears that Prince William and the royals are choosing to follow their previous strategy to avoiding the Sussex matter altogether, especially after the Thomas Markle’s arrest.

Harry and Meghan also avoided any questions about the 82-year-old, who has been arrested on the charge of possessing child abuse material.

However, Prince Harry spoke passionately about children’s protection in his speech.

“We rarely ask technology to be less ambitious. We’re told it will transform education. Cure disease. Solve problems we once thought impossible. Why should our ambition stop there?”

READ MORE: Prince Harry turns Meghan's pillar of strength in first outing amid crisis

He stressed, “All children should be able to go online and discover something wonderful. A friend. An interest that becomes a passion. A place where they feel understood.

“They deserve to feel safe wherever they are. In a classroom. On a playground. At any time, no matter where they are.”

As Prince Harry had been delivering the keynote speech at the European Parliament on Tuesday morning, the Prince of Wales team shared a statement regarding the Earthshot Prize ceremony.

“It’s almost time!” it stated. “The Earthshot Prize Awards Night 2026 lands in Mumbai on 17 November.”
It noted that “five of our 15 incredible Finalists will each win £1 million to scale their solutions” and revealed the performers for the evening.
It appears that Prince William and the royals are choosing to follow their previous strategy to avoiding the Sussex matter altogether, especially after the Thomas Markle’s arrest.
Harry and Meghan also avoided any questions about the 82-year-old, who has been arrested on the charge of possessing child abuse material.
However, Prince Harry spoke passionately about children’s protection in his speech.
“We rarely ask technology to be less ambitious. We’re told it will transform education. Cure disease. Solve problems we once thought impossible. Why should our ambition stop there?”

He stressed, “All children should be able to go online and discover something wonderful. A friend. An interest that becomes a passion. A place where they feel understood.
“They deserve to feel safe wherever they are. In a classroom. On a playground. At any time, no matter where they are.”

headline: Heartbroken Kate finally gives up on her Harry plan
subheadline: Princess Kate knows that peace built on pressure will break again, but peace built on patience will last forever
author: Shehzad Hameed
article_text:
Princess Kate, who once tried with all her heart to bring Prince Harry back as the royal family's peacemaker, has finally stepped back from the mission backed by the British monarch.

The Princess of Wales now understands the painful complications as Harry still sees everything through Meghan Markle's eyes, and some hearts cannot be brought home until they are ready to see for themselves.

The futre Queen, according to an insider close to the Waleses, "still wants William and Harry to make peace and strenghten their father's reign but she won't indulge in any such process that could put dout or attention on her intention."

The insider went on, "She has not stopped loving Harry, she has simply stopped forcing a reunion that is not ready. She knows that peace built on pressure will break again, but peace built on patience will last forever."

READ MORE: 'Stubborn' William, Harry sad truth: They don't need each other anymore

Some experts and commentators believe that one day, brotherly love will find its own way back home.

The future Queen, according to an insider close to the Waleses, "still wants William and Harry to make peace and strengthen their father's reign, but she will no longer chase a process that puts doubt on her pure intention. True peacemakers don't force peace, they protect it."

Princess Catherine is little bit heartbroken with her brother-in-law's unnecessary attacks on William and the rest of the royal family.

headline: Meghan Markle puts her trauma aside to console grieving mother
subheadline: The Duchess of Sussex fights back tears during emotional encounter in Brussels
author: Areeba Khan
article_text:
Meghan Markle did not let the controversy surrounding her father, Thomas Markle, stop her from consoling a grieving mother, and the emotional moment was caught on camera.

Archie and Lilibet's parents have taken part in a meaningful engagement, the opening of the Lost Screen Memorial, to hold tech giants accountable and promote safer online spaces for kids.

The couple attended a session in the European Parliament in Brussels, where Harry delivered a crucial speech, stressing that every child deserves to feel safe and protected.

READ MORE: Prince Harry breaks silence on children safety after Thomas Markle arrest

A heartfelt video shared by renowned journalist Chris Ship showed Meghan — already stressed after her father's arrest for possession of child abuse images — standing up to hug a devastated mother.

It can be seen that Meghan stood up from her seat and hugged Glenn De Cooman, who lost her 15-year-old child to suicide after a naked photo of him was shared online.

The tragic event took place in Belgium in 2017.

READ MORE: Meghan Markle steps back from Harry's plan — here's why

In her first outing since her father's arrest, Meghan put on a brave face, but the feelings of stress and tension were apparently visible on her face.

headline: Chicago Heights police seek owner of Nickelodeon jacket found with human remains
subheadline: Chicago Heights police: Do you recognise this jacket found with human remains? The remains of a human body were discovered on Sunday, November 8, near Chicago Road and Elmwood Drive
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The Chicago police have sought public help in locating the owner of a jacket recovered as evidence after discovery of human remains inside a garbage can in Chicago Heights.

The remains of a human body were discovered on Sunday, November 8, near Chicago Road and Elmwood Drive.

The police officials have since confirmed they are skeletal remains tied to an unidentified person.

Police confirmed the discovery and shifted the remains to the Cook County Medical Examiner’s Office for further analysis.

On Monday, November 9, the skeletal remains were examined by the medical examiner’s office, but the details of the results are still awaited.

Officers responded around 11:50 a.m. on Sunday, November 8, after a resident reported the discovery near Chicago Road and Elmwood.

The Chicago police have described it as a “Member’s Only, size XXL, unisex Nickelodeon down-style jacket.”

The investigators have not yet ascertained the identity of the victim.

The Chicago Heights Investigation Division and the South Suburban Major Crimes Task Force are investigating the case.

The Chicago Heights police have asked anyone with details to call them at 708-756-6400.

The recent incident reportedly marked the third such case in which human remains were found in garbage cans in the Chicago area this year.

In early July, the remains of Zenobia Wetherspoon were found in a garbage can in Chicago’s Back of the Yards neighbourhood.

Later in July, two legs and part of a skull were found inside another garbage can near East 68th Street, per ABC 7 Eyewitness News.

headline: Johnny Depp makes emotional confession after return to Hollywood
subheadline: Johnny’s return came after years of legal battles with ex-wife Amber Heard
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Johnny Depp has made a big return to Hollywood after eight years and the actor shared an emotional message for the fans who stood by him during his difficult years.

The star was seen at UK premiere of his new film Ebenezer where he spoke about how much their support means to him.

Depp plays the famous miser from Charles Dickens' Christmas story. So while speaking to reporters on the red carpet, he was asked about the welcome he received from his fans.

The Hollywood icon, however, shared that there were no words to explain how he felt, also adding that these were the people who supported him through good and bad times.

READ MORE: Johnny Depp sets one major condition for his return as Jack Sparrow

His last major Hollywood film, meanwhile, was Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald in 2018, where he played the villain Gellert Grindelwald.

Although he stayed away from big Hollywood projects, he continued acting in films such as Minamata and Jeanne du Barry.

Depp also been busy promoting Ebenezer. During an event in New York, the star appeared dressed as his character in a black coat and top hat.

He even pushed over a Christmas tree, bringing the character's dislike of Christmas to life.

READ MORE: Netflix confirms major plans for 'Twilight' animated show

Johnny’s return came after years of legal battles with ex-wife Amber Heard.

headline: KATSEYE to resume tour with 'some precautions' amid Megan's concussion
subheadline: Megan Skiendiel will return to the stage as KATSEYE resumes the 'Wildworld Tour'
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Megan Skiendiel will join KATSEYE as they resume their Wildworld Tour despite getting a concussion last week.

After a week-long break, the iconic girl group will take the stage at Austin’s Moody Center on Tuesday, November 10. But given her condition, Megan will not be able to go “full out” just yet.

“While I’m feeling so much better, I am still actively recovering from my concussion so I’ll need to take some precautions as I continue to heal,” she explained in a statement.

READ MORE: KATSEYE postpones more shows as Megan Skiendiel reveals she has a concussion

The 20-year-old said that she will be performing on a “modified schedule,” which means “reduced choreography, less intense movement, and taking breaks as needed.”

“I won’t be going full out just yet!” Megan added. “My doctors have recommended these limitations for now and I’ll need to be reassessed before returning to unrestricted performances.”

She said she’s “excited to be back on stage” even if she has to “do things a little differently this time.”

“Thank you for all the love, patience and support. It means more than you know. I love you guys!” the statement concluded.

Last week, Megan, Daniela, Lara, and Yoonchae — four of the six members who are currently active due to Sophia and Manon’s ongoing hiatuses — postponed their Detroit concert 30 minutes before it began, leaving many fans stranded.

They also postponed their Chicago and Minneapolis concerts that week.

The girls insisted that although they “tried everything” to make a 3-woman show possible, they couldn’t due to “circumstances and commitments beyond our control.”

Megan also explained that she wanted to make the show happen regardless of her concussion but was “strongly advised by medical professionals” to take a break.

READ MORE: KATSEYE explains last-minute cancellation of concert amid backlash

headline: Taylor Swift sparks 'Debut' hopes with cryptic newsletter to fans
subheadline: Taylor Swift causes stir among Swifties after surprising reconciliation
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Taylor Swift caused a hubbub among the Swifties this week - after her unexpected reunion with Karlie Kloss, and then an unexpected newsletter in their inboxes.

The 36-year-old pop superstar circulated an email via Taylor Nation, which asked fans to sign up for text messages to get updates regarding "news, offerings, or promotions."

The Anti-Hero hitmaker's notification set Swifties on high alert as they had already been theorising about Debut (Taylor's Version) and Reputation (Taylor's Version) for a while.

READ MORE: Taylor Swift sparks 'Debut (TV)' speculations with new social media update

Swifties promptly flocked to social media and wrote, "not the number being 871313," noting the numerological reference to Travis Kelce's jersey number 87 and Swift's lucky number 13.

"Swiftmas is coming omfg….," someone predicted, while a third chimed in, "ts13 i can smell you."

More added, "oh taylor's team ate with this," and "oh debutation we’re ready for you," as well as "karlie kloss reunion and then thiss?? oh debutation," theorised another.

While one penned, "oh they're activating the swifties wallet. something is coming."

headline: Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's mood leaves fans questioning their exit
subheadline: Travis Kelce was driving the car while Taylor Swift sat beside him
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce were seen leaving the Kansas City Chiefs game together on Sunday but their serious faces caught everyone's attention.

The couple did not look very happy as they drove away from Arrowhead Stadium in a cream coloured Cadillac, even though the Chiefs had just won their game against the New York Jets by 35 to 12.

Kelce, however, was driving the car while Swift sat beside him. The vintage Cadillac is another addition to the NFL star's love for classic cars.

His interest in old vehicles was also part of his wedding celebrations with Swift.

READ MORE: Taylor Swift, Karlie Kloss leave fans stunned with unexpected reunion

A 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS convertible was reportedly placed on display at their wedding reception in July as well.

The car had special number plate that read 'JST&T MRD'. It was also the same model they drove after Swift attended her first Chiefs game in September 2023, when their romance first got public.

Swift's mother, Andrea, was also at Sunday's game to support Kelce. She wore a shirt with the words 'Karma is the guy on the Chiefs', referring to her daughter's famous song.

READ MORE: Johnny Depp makes emotional confession after return to Hollywood

Another familiar face in the crowd was Karlie Kloss as she sat beside Taylor, marking their first public appearance together in years.

headline: Ozempic's new warning: GLP-1 weight loss drugs linked to rare vision loss
subheadline: FDA flags rare blindness risk in drugs like Zepbound, Ozempic
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has announced that GLP-1 drugs used for weight loss and diabetes must carry warnings about a rare risk of vision loss.

The agency informed patients and healthcare providers on Monday, November 9, of a potential increased risk of non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION), a serious eye condition.

The requirement applies to Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro and Zepbound as well as Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic and Wegovy. Manufacturers must add information about the potential risk to the “Warnings and precautions” section of product labelling.

NAION is a common cause of sudden, painless vision loss and may lead to permanent sight impairment in some cases. It results from decreased blood flow to the front part of the optic nerve, though the underlying cause remains incompletely understood.

The FDA said it assesses clinical trial data, animal data, and post-marketing data, including observational studies and case reports.

Both manufacturers responded to the development. A Lilly spokesperson noted that the FDA’s communication applies to all medicines with GLP-1 RA activity and doesn’t reference findings specific to Lilly medicines, adding that the company is evaluating the update.

Novo said it continues to believe the data do not establish a cause-and-effect relationship and remains confident in the benefit-risk profiles of its medicines.

The European Medicines Agency’s safety committee previously said NAION may affect up to 1 in 10,000 people taking semaglutide for at least one year. A large 2025 study tracking nearly 175,000 diabetic patients found the risk of NAION more than doubled after two years of GLP-1 treatment compared with other diabetes medicines.

headline: Cardi B, Travis Scott set to lead ‘Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival'
subheadline: Grand Theft Auto VI will arrive on November 19
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Cardi B, Travis Scott and many other popular artists are set to perform at a huge music festival celebrating the release of Grand Theft Auto VI.

The special event will take place in Miami on November 21, just two days after the much awaited game arrives.

The festival, called Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, will be held at Mana Wynwood. The venue will be turned into a place inspired by Leonida, the fictional location featured in the game.

READ MORE: Cardi B recalls 'uncertain' pregnancy as son with ex Stefon Diggs turns 1

Fans, however, who want to attend cannot simply buy tickets straight away. They must first enter an online lottery through DiceFM for a chance to purchase up to two tickets.

Entries close on November 10 and selected fans can buy tickets from November 11.

Travis Scott will lead a special performance with his Cactus Jack team, including Don Toliver and Sofaygo.

Kodak Black, whereas, will also join them as a guest. Cardi B, Rauw Alejandro, Metro Boomin and several other artists are part of the lineup.

The event, moreover, will also feature DJ performances from Justice and Nick León, along with more live music throughout the night.

READ MORE: Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's mood leaves fans questioning their exit

The festival is part of the game's big launch plans. Grand Theft Auto VI will arrive on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, along with a 34 song album featuring many major artists.
