headline: Sarah Ferguson ready to face court for Andrew
subheadline: Princesses beatrice and Eugenie's mother Fergie will do anything to save anything
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Sarah Ferguson, who has been fearlessly maintaining her ties with ex-husband Andrew, could face court for her former husband, an expert has warned.

The former Duchess of York re-emerged with high spirits as if nothing had happened to her, even after she lost charities, book deals and her title over renewed scrutiny of her Epstein connections.

A royal commentator claimed: "It is not surprising."The two have remained cordial and supportive as co-parents and co-grandparents amid their fall from grace.

RREAD MORE: Andrew's 'love interest' breaks silence after Sarah Ferguson return

However, Richard Fitzwilliams claimed: "If Andrew came to court, she might well be called as a witness. Much depends on whether the police in Britain can obtain the unredacted Epstein files."

He told Fox News Digital, "But there is no way back for Andrew. He hasn't helped the FBI. He has no support. He has no reputation to lose. It can't get much worse. His fall is unique. It has further to go."

Police Scotland confirmed that active inquiries are underway into information concerning Andrew and Epstein at Balmoral Castle, the royal family's Scottish estate. They noted that the inquiries are at a "very early stage."

"We have received information and active enquiries are ongoing, but these are at a very early stage," a Police Scotland spokesperson told the same outlet.

"All enquiries are evidence-led, with the needs of victim survivors at the heart of those enquiries. We would never confirm details of ongoing enquiries, and it would be inappropriate to comment further."

The Andrew and Sarah story and their continued love for each other have always been strong.

Andrew Lownie, author of "Entitled," dubbed Sarah Ferguson and Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor as the royal family's "Bonnie and Clyde," as they remained deeply loyal to each other while navigating scandals and public scrutiny throughout the years.

Andrew has also remained largely out of public view as he faces an ongoing police investigation and a witness summons in a separate civil fraud case.

"As long as Sarah is tied to Andrew, a comeback with King Charles, Prince William and Princess Catherine is almost impossible," Chard said.

"William is reportedly taking an even tougher line. With her daughters, grandchildren and close friends around her, she no doubt is plotting her public revival. Her Falklands hero and exiled ex Prince Andrew will not be in tow."

headline: Lahore tops global pollution ranking as air quality turns 'very unhealthy'
subheadline: AQI in Punjab capital recorded at 240 following Diwali celebrations in neighbouring India
author: Reuters, Web Desk
article_text:
Authorities blame pollutants from India after Diwali.
Delhi second-most polluted city after Diwali firecrackers.
Lahore's concentration of PM2.5 33 times above WHO guidelines.

Lahore has topped the global ranking of the world's most polluted cities, recording an Air Quality Index (AQI) of 240, according to an international air quality monitoring website, as toxic air continues to shroud the provincial capital.

The air quality in Punjab's capital is well within the range of "very unhealthy", according to the Swiss air quality monitor's data.

The city's PM2.5 concentration, harmful airborne particles small enough to penetrate deep into the lungs, was 33 times the World Health Organisation's annual guideline, IQAir said.

The website also recorded an AQI of 283 in Faisalabad, 245 in Peshawar and 228 in Gujranwala, highlighting poor air quality across several major cities.

Punjab authorities blamed poor air quality this week on pollution drifting from neighbouring India, where firecrackers set off during the Hindu festival of Diwali over the weekend blanketed much of the north in toxic smog.

Punjab Environment Protection Minister Marriyum Aurangzeb said light winds carried pollutants into the region from India after Diwali.

"However, air pollution is expected to gradually decrease from early afternoon as weather conditions improve and winds shift direction," she said.

India's foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

IQAir ranked Delhi the world's second-most polluted major city on Tuesday, with an AQI of 188. Indian government data showed that firecrackers were responsible for nearly 55% of the PM2.5 in the Indian capital a day earlier.

Vehicle emissions, construction dust and smoke from crop-waste burning are also major contributors to winter pollution on both sides of the border.

Pakistan had similarly attributed its toxic air in 2024 to crop-waste burning in Indian Punjab, but officials from India's weather department had said at the time that the wind direction meant the airflow was actually from Pakistan into India.

Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party has also blamed crop-waste burning in Indian Punjab — governed by a regional opposition party — for Delhi's poor air quality this month. Local media reported a sevenfold increase in farm fires in the state on Sunday, when Diwali was celebrated.

Indian Punjab's state government, however, says incidents of crop-waste burning have fallen compared with previous years.

headline: Daniel Radcliffe gives verdict on upcoming 'Harry Potter' series
subheadline: Daniel Radcliffe won't be watching new 'Harry Potter' series: Here's why
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Harry Potter series will be taking Potterheads back to the school of witches and wizards, Hogwarts, but Daniel Radcliffe is not interested in a trip down the memory lane.

The 37-year-old actor was recently asked if he would be watching the new HBO series, and he said, “I don’t know if I will [watch], honestly. I’ve watched, I’ve been in a lot of Harry Potter already… and also I don’t watch any TV… eight hours is a lot of anything to watch.”

Social media was surprised at the Kill Your Darlings star's comments, but reasoned that he must be tired of the franchise after being associated with it his entire life.

While others claimed that Radcliffe might want to distance himself from the franchise because of author J.K. Rowling's views which have come to light in recent years.

READ MORE: Daniel Radcliffe finds something he once thought impossible

One X user wrote, "he spent his entire childhood and teen years playing as harry potter i dont blame him for never wanting to see that character again," and another added, "It's a polite way of saying he doesn't want to watch that show. It's not a matter of hours. I won't watch it because I think the rights of a minority are more important than Harry Potter, and since I have nothing to do with that franchise, I can say it directly."

A third chimed in, "Dude spent half his life on the franchise. Plus IIRC, I don't think he cares for what Rowling has become and wants nothing to do with her anymore. Let him move on."

More penned, "How else he could says he doesn't care for the new remake," as well as "I don’t understand who wanted this reboot in the first place."

Meghan Markle has decided to speak out and share information related to her father, Thomas Markle, but on one condition.

Archie and Lilibet's maternal grandfather has been arrested for possession of child abuse material.

Meghan, in her earlier statement, also expressed deep concerns over the matter and put her critics to silence by sharing that her father's shocking actions were the reason he did not let Archie and Lilibet meet Thomas.

Now, an insider told Rob Shutter that the former working royal has been setting an example and is ready to share whatever she knows about her father with the FBI.

"Meghan wants to cooperate and make it clear she has nothing to hide. She is willing to speak to investigators, but she isn’t getting on a plane to America to be questioned," the source said.

Now, a contrast has been made between Meghan's willingness to speak to police and the royal family's silence throughout the Andrew-Epstein saga.

headline: Miley Cyrus still feels godmother Dolly Parton's presence
subheadline: Miley shares she can feel Dolly's presence while performing at the Hollywood Bowl
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Miley Cyrus opened up about a strange experience that made her feel her late godmother, Dolly Parton, was still around her.

The singer told fans that she believes Parton is still close to her even after her death in August.

During her Hollywood Bowl show on October 18, Cyrus shared what happened one night at home, saying that Parton had gifted her a mannequin of herself.

On that night, the Wrecking Ball hitmaker played a video of the late legend singing Jolene, lit a candle and placed a flower beside the mannequin.

READ MORE: Miley Cyrus admits performing doesn't feel 'natural' anymore

She, however, then asked Dolly to make the lights flicker if she was there. According to Cyrus, the lights started going on and off. Her fiancé, Maxx Morando, was also present and saw it happen.

Cyrus said she can feel Parton's presence while performing at the Hollywood Bowl. She told the crowd that she felt her godmother was now closer to her than ever.

At another show, the singer became emotional while talking about their bond, sharing that that nothing could ever separate them.

READ MORE: Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce's mood leaves fans questioning their exit

Miley also shared a sweet memory from Parton's concert as she had once tried to attend without being noticed, but Parton played the Hannah Montana theme song and told the crowd that her goddaughter was there.

headline: Phone ban's new rules: Pupils barred from keeping devices in bags at school
subheadline: England to ban pupils from keeping phones in bags under stricter school rules
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Pupils in England will no longer be allowed to keep mobile phones in their bags or pockets during the school day under strengthened government guidance aimed at creating “truly phone-free” schools.

Statutory guidance came into force in June, making schools and trusts legally responsible for being phone-free throughout the day. But ministers now say updated guidance, due to take effect from September 2027, will go beyond current “no see, no hear” policies, where phones can remain in pupils’ bags if they are not seen or heard.

Education Secretary Lucy Powell said the government’s “Clear message” to parents and pupils was that “school is for learning and friendship, not scrolling.”

She added: “Children shouldn’t be using smartphones at any point during the school day, full stop.”

The decision to implement and enforce the measures will rest with the schools. Some have installed sealed pouches or lockers, while others have opted to confiscate phones upon arrival or even ban them completely. The head teacher of Burnage Academy for Boys in Manchester, Karl Harrison, claimed that his school had spent £20,000 on metal detectors and phone pouches, which made social interaction better and concentration in classes increase.

The leaders of head teachers' unions claimed that more money was needed if schools were expected to implement the changes. Paul Whiteman, the general secretary of the NAHT, stated that implementing measures above the “not seen, not heard” ones "would come at a cost." Pepe Di'Iasio, the general secretary of the Association of School and College Leaders, added that it would be very significant indeed to provide lockable pouches for all pupils, and "it is not feasible unless the government puts in the funding."

The initiative was greeted by the Children's Commissioner Dame Rachel de Souza, while the Shadow Education Secretary Laura Trott claimed that Labour has finally listened.

headline: Dana White says 'no' to Trump's press secretary job offer
subheadline: President Trump later admitted that he had been joking about the appointment
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) President Dana White has rejected a bizarre offer from the United States (U.S.) President Donald Trump to become the next White House press secretary after Katie Zacharia was ousted after only five days at her job.

During a press briefing at White House on Monday, the 80-year-old Republican president was accompanied by White and Trump repeated his offer in front of the media. He previously shared the offer via a post on his Truth Social platform.

The 57-year-old American businessman rejected the job offer, saying, “I do not want to be in politics, no,” prompting Trump to jokingly express disappointment.

The unusual exchange came two days after Trump announced on Truth Social that he had offered White the job, describing his longtime friend as someone who would make an extraordinary press secretary.

However, the president later admitted that he had been joking about the appointment.

Speaking to reporters on Monday, Trump explained that he came up with the idea during a difficult day dealing with the press.

White, meanwhile, briefly took over the White House podium and invited reporters to ask him questions.

"I've always wanted to do this," he joked before declaring that he had no political ambitions.

The UFC boss also clarified that he had not formally rejected Trump when the initial announcement was made, saying he wanted the president to address the matter first.

White has maintained a close friendship with Trump for more than two decades and supported him during several presidential campaigns.

The position remains vacant following the departure of Karoline Leavitt in August and Katie Zacharia's brief five-day tenure.

During a press briefing at White House on Monday, the 80-year-old Republican president was accompanied by White and Trump repeated his offer in front of the media. He previously shared the offer via a post on his Truth Social platform.

The 57-year-old American businessman rejected the job offer, saying, “I do not want to be in politics, no,” prompting Trump to jokingly express disappointment.

The unusual exchange came two days after Trump announced on Truth Social that he had offered White the job, describing his longtime friend as someone who would make an extraordinary press secretary.

However, the president later admitted that he had been joking about the appointment.

Speaking to reporters on Monday, Trump explained that he came up with the idea during a difficult day dealing with the press.

White, meanwhile, briefly took over the White House podium and invited reporters to ask him questions.

"I've always wanted to do this," he joked before declaring that he had no political ambitions.

The UFC boss also clarified that he had not formally rejected Trump when the initial announcement was made, saying he wanted the president to address the matter first.

White has maintained a close friendship with Trump for more than two decades and supported him during several presidential campaigns.

The position remains vacant following the departure of Karoline Leavitt in August and Katie Zacharia's brief five-day tenure.

headline: Mckenna Grace continues Katniss Everdeen tribute ahead of 'Hunger Games'
subheadline: Mckenna Grace celebrates 'Hunger Games' press tour in special fashion
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Mckenna Grace has kept the Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping press tour intriguing for the fans of the franchise, as she pays homage to the series with her style choices.

The 20-year-old actress recently attended the Los Angeles premiere of the soon-to-be-released movie, and donned Katniss Everdeen's iconic dress from Catching Fire.

Fans immediately recognised the Regretting You star's dress as the one Everdeen wore at Snow's mansion party in the movie.

Fans quickly flocked to social media and shared the pictures, writing, "Making katniss everdeen proud every single time in this press tour. Love to see it from McKenna."

Another added, "Mckenna you absolute icon," and one gushed, "girl was on fire literally."

More chimed in, "MY GIRL NEVER MISSES!"

headline: David Walliams breaks silence after women accuse him of grooming, sexual harassment
subheadline: The investigation also detailed allegations of inappropriate behaviour towards female employees at Britain's Got Talent
author: Web Desk
article_text:
British comedian and Britain Got Talent judge David Williams has broken his silence after the TV entertainment personality was accused of grooming teenage girls and using his celebrity status to pursue sexual relations with young women.

According to a major joint investigation by The Guardian and ITV News published Tuesday, the 55-year-old TV star is facing multiple allegations from multiple women, including the two who claim they were only 15 when they first met Williams.

The investigation, consisting of 30 sources and supporting documents, alleges that the comedian was exploiting his fame and professional influence to have sexual relationsips over several years

One of the accuser identified by pseudonym Alex claimed Walliams first contacted her in 2004 after she handed him scripts she had written at a fan event.

She alleged that their conversations subsequently became sexual and that they had sex when she was 17.

Another woman, identified as Jade, alleged that Walliams initiated sexual contact after meeting her when she was 15.

The investigation also detailed allegations of inappropriate behaviour towards female employees at Britain's Got Talent and publishing company HarperCollins.

Walliams has denied wrongdoing, including allegations of sexual harassment and exploiting his celebrity status.

"I am not a sexual predator. I have not broken the law," he said in a statement, while acknowledging that he had sometimes behaved thoughtlessly in previous relationships.

The allegations emerged after Walliams unsuccessfully sought a High Court injunction to prevent The Guardian and ITV News from publishing their investigation.

The court rejected his application, ruling that the public interest in reporting the allegations outweighed the arguments for restricting publication.

HarperCollins ended its publishing relationship with Walliams in 2025 following concerns about his conduct.

No criminal conviction has been reported in connection with the allegations.

headline: November full moon 2026: Date, peak time, how to see Beaver supermoon
subheadline: First of three supermoons arrives November 24, 2026
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Skywatchers are in for a treat this month as the Beaver Moon, the last full Moon of autumn, rises as a supermoon on Tuesday, November 24, 2026.

Peak illumination occurs at 9:53 a.m. Eastern Time (14:53 UTC), though the Moon will be below the horizon for North American observers at that exact moment.

Because the Moon appears full to the naked eye for about a day on either side of peak, both Monday night, November 23, and Tuesday night, November 24, will offer worthwhile views.

This year’s Beaver Moon is the first of three consecutive supermoons, with December’s Cold Moon sitting roughly 360,768 kilometers from Earth, making its disc appear noticeably larger and brighter than a typical full Moon. This effect will be visible without any equipment.

The name Beaver Moon comes from two traditions. According to Algonquin and colonial sources, November marks the time when beavers have finished constructing their lodge and dam as the ground begins to freeze.

Alternatively, the name was inspired by the beginning of the fur trading period in America because November signalled the beginning of the trapping season as furs became thick and ready to withstand the cold winter. Another name for November's full Moon includes Frost Moon, Mourning Moon, Deer Rutting Moon, and Trading Moon in Cherokee culture.

The supermoon will take place two days prior to Thanksgiving and will conclude a busy month for astronomers. The peak of the Leonid meteor shower will take place during the night of November 17–18, while the Moon will be in waning crescent and therefore the night will be dark enough.

No telescope is needed to enjoy the Beaver Moon. It rises in the east near sunset, climbs high in the southern sky around midnight, and sets in the west near sunrise, a brighter marker of autumn’s close before winter takes over.

headline: SZA drops top secret bombshell after SZACHELLA announcement
subheadline: SZA reveals unreleased information about Coachella 2027
author: Web Desk
article_text:
SZA sent fans wild by revealing her Coachella takeover in 2027, and just when it couldn't get any better, she just leaked the other two headliners as well.

The 37-year-old R&B musician 'accidentally' disclosed the information while replying to a comment on her post, saying, "you can literally go see the other two headliners. I assume u must listen to lots of tame and dua lipa lol," which has now been deleted.

However, by the time the Kill Bill hitmaker deleted the comment, several fans had screenshotted and shared it all over social media, confirming the headliners and cited SZA as the source.

READ MORE: SZA confirms Coachella 2027 gig? Singer's latest post fuels buzz

Taking to X, one fan wrote, "The source [crying emojis]."

Another excited added, "this might be the best Coachella lineup so far for headliners."

A third chimed in, "Let’s gooo sza," and "reliable source."

More noted, "i just know sza is in SOOO much trouble for confirming the two headliners before actual coachella," and "i mean yeah it was gonna come out it’s just messy that sza confirmed it."

Another reasoned, "i mean they were gonna reveal the lineup any day now."

headline: Anthropic seeks $1.4 trillion valuation despite Democrats' victory rattling AI stocks: What to know
subheadline: Anthropic is planning one of the largest stock market fundraising events in history
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Claude Chatbot's parent company Anthropic is seeking $1.4 trillion valuation in blockbuster initial public offering (IPO) despite the AI stocks taking a hit after Democratic Party's sweeping victory in the U.S. midterm elections.

The artificial intelligence giant plans to sell 825 million shares at between $70 and $78 each, according to a regulatory filing on Tuesday.

With the number of shares offered, the company could raise around $64.4 billion, with an additional $26 billion expected through a private placement involving technology giants including Google, Nvidia and Microsoft.

The combined fundraising could reach $90.4 billion, making it one of the largest stock market fundraising events in history.

However, the valuation represents a sharp retreat from the $2 trillion figure discussed by investors in early October.

The change comes after a turbulent week on Wall Street, where AI-related stocks suffered heavy losses amid concerns about tighter scrutiny of data centres following Democratic gains in Congress.

The Nasdaq 100 plunged 6.4% in a single session last Thursday, erasing approximately $2.3 trillion in market value.

Investors are increasingly questioning whether the enormous sums being spent on AI infrastructure will generate sufficient returns.

Anthropic itself has nearly $900 billion in computing commitments involving major technology companies, highlighting the scale of its expansion plans.

Founded in 2021 by former OpenAI researchers, the San Francisco-based company remains unprofitable despite rapidly growing revenue.

Its IPO, expected later this month, could become a major test of investor confidence in the AI industry.

The company's shares are expected to trade on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ANT.

headline: Russell Brand's ex Jemima Goldsmith defends herself after his sentencing
subheadline: The journalist addresses claims she and Brand tried to silence a woman after her complaint against him
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Russell Brand’s ex-girlfriend Jemima Goldsmith is setting the record straight about her involvement in a 2015 court order against a woman who had filed a complaint against him.

Hours after Brand was sentenced to 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault on Monday, November 9, Goldsmith issued a lengthy statement on X to address reports suggesting that she and the comedian had tried to silence the woman over a 2014 incident.

The incident occurred when Brand, 51, and Goldsmith, 52, were dating. Goldsmith had hired a woman named Szilvia Berki to visit her home and give Brand a massage. However, the comedian changed his mind and asked her to leave. “She was clearly offended,” Goldsmith recalled.

READ MORE: Russell Brand's past interaction with Katy Perry leaves fans disgusted

The journalist claims Berki filed a police report in which she claimed Brand “pushed” her out the door and that Goldsmith’s dog “attacked” her — claims Goldsmith denies.

“I was present the whole time he was with her, and I did not see anything untoward,” she wrote on X while acknowledging that her observation does not negate the crimes Brand has committed against several other women — including herself.

Goldsmith went on to accuse Berki of launching a “campaign of vicious antisemitic and threatening abuse” against her and her family. She said the harassment left her fearing for their safety and led to the injunction.

She also clarified that she had agreed to have the order varied to allow Berki to speak to police again, but said Brand's agreement was also required.

“I have no ability to compel Brand in this matter, as I have not seen or spoken to him in over a decade,” Goldsmith notes.

Brand was sentenced after being convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. He was cleared of two additional rape charges and attempted indecent assault.

headline: Duchess Sophie finds how simple bar of soap is helping women rebuild their lives
subheadline: Duchess Sophie brings colour to Bangladesh refugee camp visit in chic printed skirt
author: Web Desk
article_text:
A longtime champion of women and children, the Duchess of Edinburgh met refugees in Bangladesh on Tuesday.

Sophie arrived at a UNICEF Learning Centre in Camp 4, Cox’s Bazar, wearing a blue printed skirt with a white blouse and a warm tan scarf.

She spent time with children living in the camp, including Year 6 pupils, hearing about their education and the challenges they face after being displaced from their homes in Myanmar.

Read More: Sophie gets into spirit of sport after touching Queen tribute

The visit formed part of the Duchess’s work on Women, Peace and Security, with a particular focus on the experiences of women and girls affected by conflict and displacement.

During the day, Sophie also visited a safe space for women and girls, where she heard about the support available to survivors and the importance of providing a secure environment in which they can speak openly about their experiences and hopes for the future.

She also toured a facility supporting people with disabilities, including an Assistive Device Repair Pilot Workshop run by Humanity & Inclusion.

One of the more practical stops on the Duchess’s visit was a soap factory operated by local NGO the Programme for Helpless and Lagged Societies (PHALS).

Sophie watched as pink blocks of soap were made and cut, and got a closer look at how it is helping women develop skills and earn an income.

More than 1.2 million Rohingya refugees have fled persecution and violence in Myanmar’s Rakhine State since 2017, seeking safety in the sprawling camps around Cox’s Bazar.

article_html:
A longtime champion of women and children, the Duchess of Edinburgh met refugees in Bangladesh on Tuesday.

Sophie arrived at a UNICEF Learning Centre in Camp 4, Cox’s Bazar, wearing a blue printed skirt with a white blouse and a warm tan scarf. 

She spent time with children living in the camp, including Year 6 pupils, hearing about their education and the challenges they face after being displaced from their homes in Myanmar.

Read More: Sophie gets into spirit of sport after touching Queen tribute

The visit formed part of the Duchess’s work on Women, Peace and Security, with a particular focus on the experiences of women and girls affected by conflict and displacement.

During the day, Sophie also visited a safe space for women and girls, where she heard about the support available to survivors and the importance of providing a secure environment in which they can speak openly about their experiences and hopes for the future.

She also toured a facility supporting people with disabilities, including an Assistive Device Repair Pilot Workshop run by Humanity & Inclusion. 

One of the more practical stops on the Duchess’s visit was a soap factory operated by local NGO the Programme for Helpless and Lagged Societies (PHALS).

Sophie watched as pink blocks of soap were made and cut, and got a closer look at how it is helping women develop skills and earn an income.

headline: No threat to Tarbela Dam's integrity, structure: Wapda
subheadline: Wapda chairman orders departmental inquiry after tunnel accident at fifth extension project
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Wapda chairman inspects intake structure, powerhouse.
Water ministry seeks comprehensive report from Wapda.
Inquiry into incident will be completed within week.

Water and Power Development Authority (Wapda) Chairman Lieutenant General (retd) Muhammad Saeed has ordered a departmental inquiry into the tunnel accident at Tarbela’s fifth extension project.

The chairman made the remarks during his visit to the Tarbela fifth extension hydropower project to review the situation after the accident and chaired a meeting at the project office.

Consultants, the contractor and Wapda teams briefed the meeting that there is no threat to the integrity of the main Tarbela Dam or any of its structures.

The meeting held a detailed discussion on the possible causes of the incident. Precautionary measures and the strategy for dealing with the current issue were also considered, and immediate response measures were finalised.

The chairman also toured the project’s intake structure, tunnel, powerhouse and other key sites. He directed the teams to cover all aspects and submit a detailed report at the earliest.

Ministry seeks report

A spokesperson for the Ministry of Water Resources said Wapda had been asked to submit a comprehensive report on the Tarbela Dam matter.

According to sources, the inquiry into the incident will be completed within a week. Experts from outside Wapda will also be included in the inquiry.

The sources added that responsibility will be fixed and the report will be submitted to the Prime Minister’s Office.

A day earlier, water entered a tunnel and the powerhouse at the dam’s 5th Extension Hydropower Project (T-5) construction site after a weak section of rock fell during excavation.

In a statement, Wapda confirmed that all workers had been safely evacuated following the water inflow incident.

A Wapda spokesperson had said the rock fell during excavation of the second bench of the connecting tunnel at the fifth extension project. Water then flowed from the intake pit into the tunnel and powerhouse, prompting the immediate evacuation of all workers.

The spokesperson said water had been completely drained from the intake pit and dewatering of the under-construction powerhouse had begun. No further water was entering the work sites on the downstream side, the spokesperson had added.

headline: ‘Monarch: Legacy of Monsters' gets exciting season 3 update
subheadline: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova, is set to arrive on March 26, 2027
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Apple TV can be preparing a major change for Monarch: Legacy of Monsters as talks for a possible third season are now underway.

The new season set to bring a new team behind the scenes, along with new monsters from the popular Monsterverse world.

According to The Hollywood Reporter and Variety, Apple TV and Legendary Television are discussing the show's return.

If the plans move forward, the third season could have a new showrunner and writing team. Variety also reported that some people have already been contacted about taking charge of the series.

READ MORE: 'Godzilla Minus Zero' heads for record breaking $32 million opening

The show, however, is about the world of Godzilla and other giant creatures. Its first season arrived in November 2023, while the second season ran from February to May this year.

Both seasons had 10 episodes.

The Monsterverse, meanwhile, is also growing with a separate series about a younger Lee Shaw, played by Wyatt Russell.

Set in 1984, the story is about his mission to stop the Soviet Union from using a Titan during the Cold War.

The franchise has also found huge success at the box office. Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire earned $570 million all over the world, making it the biggest film in the series.

READ MORE: Cardi B, Travis Scott set to lead ‘Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival'

Its next movie, Godzilla x Kong: Supernova, is set to arrive on March 26, 2027.

headline: US military jets leave UK bases as Trump declares Iran war 'effectively OVER'
subheadline: The jets were relocated to other military bases in Germany, Spain and Britain
author: Web Desk
article_text:
United States (U.S.) President Donald Trump has declared that the eight-month Iran War is “effectively over” after a crushing defeat to the Republicans in the midterms.

Speaking at a White House press briefing, the 80-year-old Republican president said that Israel and other Gulf allies were well protected and there was no need of escalating the conflict further.

However he warned, “If we have to go back in, we are locked and loaded.”

The U.S. has also moved more than a dozen military jets out of UK bases amid reports that Iran might be planning to target the sites.

According to the flight tracking data, the U.S. moved at least 10 KC-135 refuelling tankers and three Osprey aircraft from RAF Mildenhall in Suffolk on Monday.

The jets were relocated to other military bases in Germany, Spain and Britain. The government has not yet revealed the reason behind relocation of military aircraft; however, Wall Street Journal reported that the evacuation was linked to an Iranian threat.

This comes just weeks after the US withdrew its 12 B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford following an alleged security incident.

Those aircraft had previously been used in American military operations against Iran.

The developments coincide with Trump's latest remarks suggesting that the conflict could be nearing its conclusion.

Speaking after meeting Qatar's prime minister, Trump claimed Iran had been militarily defeated and said major American bombardments were unlikely to resume if Tehran agreed to a satisfactory deal.

However, the US naval blockade of Iranian ports remains in place, while thousands of American troops are still deployed in the region.

Meanwhile, US European Command said it was taking appropriate security measures but declined to discuss specific military movements.

British authorities maintained that their bases were safe and that security arrangements remained under constant review.

Iran has previously denied involvement in the suspected plot against RAF Fairford.

United States (U.S.) President Donald Trump has declared that the eight-month Iran War is “effectively over” after a crushing defeat to the Republicans in the midterms.

Speaking at a White House press briefing, the 80-year-old Republican president said that Israel and other Gulf allies were well protected and there was no need of escalating the conflict further.

However he warned, “If we have to go back in, we are locked and loaded.”

The U.S. has also moved more than a dozen military jets out of UK bases amid reports that Iran might be planning to target the sites.

According to the flight tracking data, the U.S. moved at least 10 KC-135 refuelling tankers and three Osprey aircraft from RAF Mildenhall in Suffolk on Monday.

The jets were relocated to other military bases in Germany, Spain and Britain. The government has not yet revealed the reason behind relocation of military aircraft; however, Wall Street Journal reported that the evacuation was linked to an Iranian threat.

This comes just weeks after the US withdrew its 12 B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford following an alleged security incident.

Those aircraft had previously been used in American military operations against Iran.

The developments coincide with Trump's latest remarks suggesting that the conflict could be nearing its conclusion.

Speaking after meeting Qatar's prime minister, Trump claimed Iran had been militarily defeated and said major American bombardments were unlikely to resume if Tehran agreed to a satisfactory deal.

However, the US naval blockade of Iranian ports remains in place, while thousands of American troops are still deployed in the region.

Meanwhile, US European Command said it was taking appropriate security measures but declined to discuss specific military movements.

British authorities maintained that their bases were safe and that security arrangements remained under constant review.

Iran has previously denied involvement in the suspected plot against RAF Fairford.

author: Web Desk

Lady Gaga and Bruno Mars have earned a new milestone with their collaboration, Die With A Smile, dethroning Justin Bieber and The Kid LAROI from their record.

The artists now have the 10th most-streamed song with 4.132 billion plays in the history of Spotify charts, surpassing Bieber and LAROI's collaboration, STAY.

Additionally, the Abracadabra hitmaker is the only female artist in the top 10.

As soon as the news came out, fans flocked to social media to celebrate.

headline: Country music singer's father issues warning after son's death
subheadline: CJ's father shares a message asking people to remember his son
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The country music world is mourning the death of young singer CJ Beach, who lost his life in a car crash at just 22.

The singer performed at The Salty Donkey in Panacea, Florida, on Friday night, making the news even more heartbreaking for people who just seen him perform hours earlier.

After his death, CJ's father, Charles Beach, shared a message asking people to remember his son by helping prevent another accident.

He thanked everyone who shared pictures and videos of CJ but said seeing those memories was painful for the family.

READ MORE: ‘Monarch: Legacy of Monsters' gets exciting season 3 update

Charles, however, also asked people to contact their county commissioners and demand warning lights and more signs near the curve on Rehwinkle Road.

He said another crash had happened at the exact same spot before CJ's accident. The bushes damaged in that earlier crash had not even grown back.

Friends and fellow, meanwhile, musicians have been sharing stories about the young singer. Many remembered him as someone who loved music and made everyone around him feel welcome.

READ MORE: Miley Cyrus still feels godmother Dolly Parton's presence

CJ performed with his group, CJ and the Deadmen, and started the Deadman Walking Festival to give local artists a place to perform.

The festival held its fifth event in April. His sudden death has left the local music community heartbroken.

headline: Duchess Sophie's surprise appearance with REME members ahead of Remembrance
subheadline: Duchess Sophie unveils stallion memorial crafted by 26 military metalsmiths
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The Duchess of Edinburgh made an unannounced appearance ahead of Remembrance Day, joining members of the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers (REME) for a ceremony.

As Colonel-in-Chief of REME, Sophie attended the unveiling of a new memorial at the Royal British Legion National Remembrance Gardens.

The gathering brought together serving personnel, veterans and their families to remember the fallen and pay tribute to the Corps’ long history of service.

Read More: Duchess Sophie finds how simple bar of soap is helping women

Taking pride of place was a rearing stallion sculpture, crafted by 26 REME metalsmiths. The impressive creation pays tribute to the Corps’ heritage and recognises generations of personnel whose dedication and sacrifice have shaped its history.

View this post on Instagram A post shared by British Army (@britisharmy)

It also coincided with REME’s 84th birthday, as members of the Corps came together to celebrate their shared history while remembering those who never returned home.

The British Army later shared photographs from the engagement on Instagram, revealing Sophie’s previously unannounced visit.

Its post described how the family had gathered to “remember, reflect and honour” those who had made the ultimate sacrifice.

Speaking about the annual Memorial Day, Colonel Iain Wallace OBE ADC, Corps Colonel REME, said it was an opportunity to pause and remember those who had given their lives for the nation.

headline: Florence Pugh mourns her 'The Wonder' director Sebastián Lelio
subheadline: The Oscar-winning filmmaker was found dead at his home at the age of 52
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Florence Pugh is remembering her The Wonder director Sebastián Lelio as “an absolute sparkling jewel” after his passing at age 52.

In a lengthy tribute posted to her Instagram on Monday, November 9, the Oscar-nominated actress admitted that her “brain is having a hard time accepting” that her friend — who she met five years ago on the period psychological drama — is gone.

“My heart is broken. He was a man who was so firmly on our side,” Pugh, 30, wrote. “He cared so deeply for women, he dedicated his work to telling the stories of women and all of the different hardships and pain.”

READ MORE: Oscar winning director Sebastián Lelio found dead at 52

The East of Eden star went on to share the mutual passion for food that she and Lelio “fell in love over,” including meat, stews, cheese, and, especially, red wine.

“So it’s not lost on me that right before I’d found out about his passing, I’d purchased a special cut of beef and a special red wine, almost as a preparation for his mourning,” Pugh recalled. “I cooked it. Drank it. And thought and spoke of how unique and mesmerising he was. I smiled through tears as I looked at my plate because I knew he would have smiled at it too.”

The Little Women alum remembered the Oscar-winning filmmaker as patient, gentle, and a brilliant artist and director “whose actions in his art made a difference.”

“The loss has really hurt my heart, and a big painful reminder that we don’t have forever,” Pugh added. “Sending my love and deep warm hugs to his family and friends. I’m so sorry for your massive loss. Sebastian, I love you dear friend. I’m cheersing to you. Always. X.”

View this post on Instagram A post shared by Florence Pugh (@florencepugh)

Lelio was found dead at his home in Santiago, Chile, by his partner, actress Amalia Kassai, on Friday. A cause of death has not been confirmed, though his family revealed that he died after health complications.

article_html:
Florence Pugh is remembering her The Wonder director Sebastián Lelio as “an absolute sparkling jewel” after his passing at age 52. 

In a lengthy tribute posted to her Instagram on Monday, November 9, the Oscar-nominated actress admitted that her “brain is having a hard time accepting” that her friend — who she met five years ago on the period psychological drama — is gone.

“My heart is broken. He was a man who was so firmly on our side,” Pugh, 30, wrote. “He cared so deeply for women, he dedicated his work to telling the stories of women and all of the different hardships and pain.”

READ MORE: Oscar winning director Sebastián Lelio found dead at 52

The East of Eden star went on to share the mutual passion for food that she and Lelio “fell in love over,” including meat, stews, cheese, and, especially, red wine.

“So it’s not lost on me that right before I’d found out about his passing, I’d purchased a special cut of beef and a special red wine, almost as a preparation for his mourning,” Pugh recalled. “I cooked it. Drank it. And thought and spoke of how unique and mesmerising he was. I smiled through tears as I looked at my plate because I knew he would have smiled at it too.”

The Little Women alum remembered the Oscar-winning filmmaker as patient, gentle, and a brilliant artist and director “whose actions in his art made a difference.”

“The loss has really hurt my heart, and a big painful reminder that we don’t have forever,” Pugh added. “Sending my love and deep warm hugs to his family and friends. I’m so sorry for your massive loss. Sebastian, I love you dear friend. I’m cheersing to you. Always. X.”

Lelio was found dead at his home in Santiago, Chile, by his partner, actress Amalia Kassai, on Friday. A cause of death has not been confirmed, though his family revealed that he died after health complications.

headline: Is Meghan Markle's future really at stake because of her father?
subheadline: Meghan Markle is said to be standing at a painful crossroads
author: Shehzad Hameed
article_text:
Meghan Markle is said to be standing at a painful crossroads where she could lose her peace, her reputation, her royal future and the trust she fought so hard to rebuild.

The Duchess of Sussex is being dragged into headlines for all the wrong reasons, with commentators warning Prince Harry's wife may lose more than her accused father if Thomas Markle is found guilty.

An insider claims the scandal could be the final blow to Meghan's royal future for good.

"Meghan Markle is cooked, and unless her father is miraculously found to be not guilty, the stain... might just become the straw that breaks the camel's back, or in her case, the HRH," the insider claimed to Royal Rundown's Substack.

And honestly, the claims may not be entirely wrong. Given the years of relentless media scrutiny and the present circumstances, the Sussexes are genuinely struggling to rebuild their brand.

Every new scandal makes their comeback harder, and every controversy makes the public question their future.

It comes after Thomas Markle Sr, 82, was arrested by FBI agents in Florida and placed under house arrest after being charged with offences related to child sexual abuse material.

He has denied the allegations. Meghan has already made her position clear in a bold statement, saying she is "deeply distressed" by the allegations.

Meghan's fans have rushed to her defence, insisting children, even if they are adults, cannot and should not be held accountable for the alleged actions of their parents.

So why could her father's mistakes still cause her downfall, even after she cut ties and condemned any such acts?

Undoubtedly, perception matters more than truth. Meghan is being judged not for what she did, but for whose daughter she is.

Yet look at Princess Eugenie and Princess Beatrice. After their parents' downfall and after all the headlines about their father Andrew's alleged links to Jeffrey Epstein and their mother Sarah's fall from grace, the two sisters still shine.

They continue their charity work, they still show up and they never publicly condemned their parents.

So if Eugenie and Beatrice can survive their parents' scandal without denouncing them, why is Meghan being punished even after she did distance herself?

That is the real question. And that is why Meghan's story is not about her father's sins, it is about how unfairly the world chooses who to forgive, and who to destroy.

And yet, beyond the pressure, the isolation and the whispers about money and inheritance, one truth always remains: a woman is not defined by someone else's mistakes, even if he is her father.

History has proven that the strongest women are made in their darkest moments. This could be the moment the Duchess stops surviving and starts rising, stronger, wiser and more fearless than ever before.

Because sometimes, when everything falls apart, that is when a queen is truly born.

headline: Dua Lipa sends fans into frenzy with first glimpse into fourth album
subheadline: Dua Lipa takes over internet with new song 'Pixie' among Coachella buzz
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Dua Lipa is seemingly done with her fourth album that she has been teasing on social media, sharing snaps from her studio sessions with fans.

The 31-year-old pop superstar is now going viral on social media after she registered a new song on ASCAP.

A fan account posted a screenshot on X, which claimed that the Levitating hitmaker had registered a new single called, PIXIE DUST, which appears to be the lead single from her upcoming fourth album.

READ MORE: Dua Lipa teases new album with latest photo dump

Excited fans flocked to the comments, and cheered, "WE’RE SO BACK," and "hope its better than her last album. LIke legit future nostalgia was iconic on so many levels."

A third chimed in, "well yes!," and another theorised, "Could Dua Lipa be on the GTA VI soundtrack?? And there are still so many artists yet to be confirmed."

More added, "my goshh," and "SAT."

headline: Jensen Huang divorce: How much could his wife Lori Huang get?
subheadline: Jensen Huang affair sparks divorce speculation, wife could get $75 billion
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s admission of an extramarital affair has sparked speculation that his wife, Lori Huang, could walk away with roughly half of his $155.2 billion fortune if the couple divorces.

This calculation hinges on one single number: Forbes estimated that Jensen Huang’s net worth stood at around $155.2 billion on November 9, 2026.

Since the couple got married in 1985 and Nvidia was established only in 1993, the entirety of his stock holding in Nvidia, more than 3.5%, thus making him the largest single investor in the company, was accumulated within the course of their marriage.

Given that California recognizes community property, where any asset obtained in the course of marriage belongs to both partners and is divided 50/50 in case of a divorce, unless proven to be otherwise, this provides an absolute solution: $77.6 billion. And that is how we obtain the range of values mentioned by most sources from $75 to $77.5 billion.

The stock has been very volatile—the stock fell 4.3% on November 9, reducing the market capitalization by almost $200 billion and falling more than 9% in the days prior—which means that the headline number could change a lot even before any calculation of the settlement is made. At minimum, it would be twice as much as MacKenzie Scott's approximate $36 billion Amazon stock from her divorce from Jeff Bezos, making it the biggest billionaire divorce settlement in history.

However, the final figure can turn out to be significantly less than implied by the basic 50/50 split.

The 2026 proxy statement of Nvidia names Lori Huang as one of the co-trustees of family trusts with more than 528 million shares as of March 2026, while assets in trust structures do not always divide equally like community property.

Moreover, it is unknown whether the couple has signed a prenuptial or postnuptial agreement that designates particular property, and Huang can also try to claim separate property. Since California is a no-fault state, his infidelity will not influence property division.

Huang disclosed the affair in a memo to Nvidia employees on November 8, acknowledging he had been “unfaithful to my wife” and apologizing to his family and staff.

He said he intends to continue leading the company.

headline: Defiant Hegseth blasts impeachment effort ahead of House vote
subheadline: US defence chief Hegseth faces impeachment over alleged abuse of power
author: Reuters
article_text:
Republican Thomas Massie introduces eight impeachment articles.
Trump renews support for embattled defence secretary.
Senate conviction unlikely despite potential House approval.

WASHINGTON: Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday blasted efforts to impeach him as a farce that would embolden US adversaries, as he lashed out at his political opponents in Congress and the media in an unapologetic defence of his record.

Striking a defiant tone at a Pentagon news briefing, Hegseth thanked President Donald Trump for his continued support as the House of Representatives scheduled a procedural vote for late Tuesday that will test support for his impeachment.

Hegseth said past impeachments of Trump had ultimately failed, and added:

"Both times he came back stronger, and the American people sent him back to the White House. Now they're trying a third time. This time against a member of his cabinet."

US Representative Thomas Massie, a Kentucky Republican, introduced eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth on Monday. Massie said in a post on X that if the House of Representatives can overcome Tuesday's procedural effort, "we will proceed to a real debate and vote on the Articles of Impeachment."

Congressional sources say the resolution may have the votes to pass even with Trump’s Republicans still controlling the House until Democrats take over on January 3. Conviction appears unlikely in the Senate, however, where a two-thirds majority is required and Republicans hold 53 of 100 seats.

Hegseth is accused of various abuses of power in office, including issuing orders to go to war with Iran without an imminent threat or approval from Congress.

Voter anger over the Iran war helped Democrats win control of Congress in last week's midterm elections. A new Reuters/Ipsos poll published on Tuesday found a majority of Americans want the newly elected Democratic-majority US Congress to act to end the war with Iran.

Vice President JD Vance has publicly questioned the war. Hegseth declined to be drawn into responding to Vance, but defended the conflict, calling Trump courageous and saying Iran's military has been left in ruins.

"History will judge the Iran war quite differently than the conventional wisdom right now," he said.

Hegseth cited US Secretary of State Marco Rubio as saying of the war: "It's not necessarily popular, but it may have been necessary, and that's certainly how I feel. It was a necessary undertaking."

Trump repeated his backing of Hegseth in a post on his Truth Social platform just after the Pentagon briefing ended.

"Pete Hegseth gets an 'A' PLUS, PLUS, PLUS for his defense against a disgruntled, angry, defeated, former Congressman, Thomas Massie, a TOTAL LOSER!" he wrote.

A polarising figure in American politics, Hegseth would be the first US defence secretary to be impeached. The last time any civilian leader of the US military was impeached was in 1876, when William Belknap held the title "secretary of war."

Hegseth, a former Fox News host, calls himself secretary of war, part of his effort to rebrand a military he said was too weak and "woke" when he took office last year.

But even some Republicans say his strained relations with Congress are becoming a political liability as the administration seeks a $1.5 trillion defence spending package.

In a possible nod to the spending requests, Hegseth said Republicans should use their final weeks in control of Congress to deliver wins for the American people instead of pursuing his impeachment.

If he's still around next year, Democrats have promised to investigate Hegseth and his handling of the Pentagon, including his firing of the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and other top military officers.

Striking a defiant tone at a Pentagon news briefing, Hegseth thanked President Donald Trump for his continued support as the House of Representatives scheduled a procedural vote for late Tuesday that will test support for his impeachment.
Hegseth said past impeachments of Trump had ultimately failed, and added:
"Both times he came back stronger, and the American people sent him back to the White House. Now they're trying a third time. This time against a member of his cabinet."

US Representative Thomas Massie, a Kentucky Republican, introduced eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth on Monday. Massie said in a post on X that if the House of Representatives can overcome Tuesday's procedural effort, "we will proceed to a real debate and vote on the Articles of Impeachment."

Congressional sources say the resolution may have the votes to pass even with Trump’s Republicans still controlling the House until Democrats take over on January 3. Conviction appears unlikely in the Senate, however, where a two-thirds majority is required and Republicans hold 53 of 100 seats.
Hegseth is accused of various abuses of power in office, including issuing orders to go to war with Iran without an imminent threat or approval from Congress.

Voter anger over the Iran war helped Democrats win control of Congress in last week's midterm elections. A new Reuters/Ipsos poll published on Tuesday found a majority of Americans want the newly elected Democratic-majority US Congress to act to end the war with Iran.

Vice President JD Vance has publicly questioned the war. Hegseth declined to be drawn into responding to Vance, but defended the conflict, calling Trump courageous and saying Iran's military has been left in ruins.
"History will judge the Iran war quite differently than the conventional wisdom right now," he said.
Hegseth cited US Secretary of State Marco Rubio as saying of the war: "It's not necessarily popular, but it may have been necessary, and that's certainly how I feel. It was a necessary undertaking."
Trump repeated his backing of Hegseth in a post on his Truth Social platform just after the Pentagon briefing ended.
"Pete Hegseth gets an 'A' PLUS, PLUS, PLUS for his defense against a disgruntled, angry, defeated, former Congressman, Thomas Massie, a TOTAL LOSER!" he wrote.

A polarising figure in American politics, Hegseth would be the first US defence secretary to be impeached. The last time any civilian leader of the US military was impeached was in 1876, when William Belknap held the title "secretary of war."
Hegseth, a former Fox News host, calls himself secretary of war, part of his effort to rebrand a military he said was too weak and "woke" when he took office last year.
But even some Republicans say his strained relations with Congress are becoming a political liability as the administration seeks a $1.5 trillion defence spending package.
In a possible nod to the spending requests, Hegseth said Republicans should use their final weeks in control of Congress to deliver wins for the American people instead of pursuing his impeachment.

If he's still around next year, Democrats have promised to investigate Hegseth and his handling of the Pentagon, including his firing of the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and other top military officers.

headline: PM Shehbaz calls for building economically stronger, energy-secure Pakistan
subheadline: “Pakistan will not wait for anyone, but will build its own future through its hard work and untiring efforts,” says premier
author: APP
article_text:
PM lauds dedication of engineers, technicians and workers.
Premier says event reaffirms Pakistan-China all-weather friendship.
Calls C-5 project manifestation of clean, emissions-free electricity.

MIANWALI: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Tuesday called for building an economically dominant, energy-independent and environmentally resilient Pakistan, declaring that the country will harness its resources, technology and human capital to secure a prosperous future.

Addressing the dome placement ceremony of the Chashma-5 Nuclear Power Plant (C-5), the prime minister described the milestone as a reflection of Pakistan’s determination to shape its own future through hard work, technological advancement and strategic partnerships.

The premier, while emphasising the importance of energy security, said Chashma-5 represented much more than steel and concrete — rather, it was a promise of clean, reliable, and affordable electricity that would strengthen the national economy and improve people’s lives.

He said that nuclear power would reduce Pakistan’s dependence on imported fuels and international price fluctuations while ensuring a stable electricity supply for industries, hospitals, educational institutions and households.

“Pakistan will not wait for anyone, but will build its own future through its hard work and untiring efforts,” the prime minister recalled, referring to his commitment at the project’s groundbreaking ceremony in July 2023.

He noted with satisfaction that the dome had been installed less than three and a half years after the groundbreaking, ahead of schedule, and expressed confidence that the project would also be commissioned earlier than planned.

The prime minister stressed that Pakistan, as a climate-vulnerable country, had a particular responsibility to pursue energy solutions that simultaneously advance economic development and protect the environment.

Highlighting the strategic importance of national security for economic progress, he said no country could build a prosperous future without first safeguarding its present.

He acknowledged the role of the armed forces under the leadership of Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, in ensuring security and stability.

Referring to the country’s experience during Marka-e-Haq, the prime minister praised the professionalism, courage and resolve of the armed forces, saying a secure environment was essential for attracting investment, reviving the economy and accelerating socioeconomic development.

He also appreciated CDF Munir’s support for the government’s economic revival and development initiatives.

Underscoring Pakistan-China strategic cooperation, PM described Chashma-5 as another enduring symbol of the two countries’ all-weather friendship and their shared commitment to economic progress.

He said the project marked the seventh nuclear power unit China had helped Pakistan construct, reflecting the consistency and strength of bilateral cooperation across challenging times.

The prime minister conveyed his gratitude to Chinese President Xi Jinping, the Chinese government and the China National Nuclear Corporation for their continued support, acknowledging the contributions of Chinese engineers and their Pakistani counterparts.

He further stated that the second phase of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) would open new economic opportunities, strengthen strategic ties and contribute to a brighter future for both countries.

The prime minister, while congratulating the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission (PAEC), China Atomic Energy Authority, China National Nuclear Corporation, contractors, engineers, financial institutions and other stakeholders, also acknowledged the people of Mianwali for hosting the landmark project.

The PM expressed hope that Chashma-5 would remain a lasting symbol of Pakistan-China friendship and shared aspirations for peace, stability and prosperity.

Earlier, the PAEC Chairman highlighted nuclear energy’s growing contribution to Pakistan’s electricity mix and national energy security. He said the country’s nuclear power plants were safely and efficiently generating 3,530 megawatts of electricity, helping avoid approximately 15 million tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions annually.

Nuclear energy currently accounts for around 16.6% of Pakistan’s electricity generation despite representing only 8.6% of installed power capacity. Its contribution rises to approximately 26% during winter.

The Chashma-5 project will have a generation capacity of 1,200 megawatts and is expected to begin electricity production in September 2030.

headline: Details about Maya Jama's major Netflix project
subheadline: Maya Jama quits 'Love Island UK' as host
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Maya Jama's exit from Love Island has come with a big surprise, as the presenter has already secured an exciting new deal with Netflix.

Just a day after announcing that she was leaving the popular dating show, news broke that she had signed a global deal with the streaming platform to work on many projects.

Maya spent three years hosting Love Island and became one of the most popular faces of the show. She took over the role at the age of 28 and hosted nine seasons during her time on the programme.

While fans may be sad to see her leave, Maya seems ready to try something different and explore new opportunities.

READ MORE: Maya Jama follows Kim Kardashian's path to fame

She is already familiar with Netflix after making her acting debut in the second season of The Gentlemen.

Maya played Aisha, who works with Susie, played by Kaya Scodelario. She is also set to return when the show comes back for its third season.

Details about her other Netflix projects are still being kept secret. However, the platform's UK content boss, Anne Mensah, praised Maya's energy and said they were delighted to have her as a bigger part of Netflix.

READ MORE: ‘Monarch: Legacy of Monsters' gets exciting season 3 update

Maya is equally excited and has promised that some interesting projects are on the way.

headline: GTA 6 release date nears: Xfinity, Spectrum offer free speed boosts for launch
subheadline: ISPs race to offer free speed boosts ahead of GTA 6 release
author: Web Desk
article_text:
In light of Grand Theft Auto VI launching on November 19, two US internet providers, Xfinity and Spectrum, have decided to battle for gamers' attention by offering free speed increases during the time when a huge pre-load will happen.

Xfinity announced on November 9 that eligible Xfinity Internet customers would get access to a 15-day free WiFi speed increase up to 2 Gbps, which will give them a chance to download GTA VI in just 30 minutes.

The speed increase will be available for use starting now through December 3, with speeds lasting 15 days after the redemption. Xfinity anticipates that the busiest week in its network's history will happen on November 10-19 when the pre-loads become accessible.

Spectrum introduced a similar program on November 4, where eligible internet users would get a free Gig Speed Lift from November 9 to 30. This increase can be redeemed via the My Spectrum App and boosts the user to Spectrum Internet 1 Gig, or 2 Gig in selected areas.

This is because the period falls close to Thanksgiving, during which many people tend to stream football games, use the video call feature, and shop online Black Friday sales concurrently.

In this context, the above discounts follow the announcement made by Rockstar Games, indicating that digital pre-loading of GTA 6 is set to start on November 10 at midnight (local time) on the PlayStation 5 and 12 a.m. GMT for the Xbox Series X|S. In this regard, one needs between 187 and 212 GB of storage to access the pre-loaded file of GTA VI.

It is worth noting that GTA VI is the first main series in about a decade, following the record-breaking premiere of its trailer that attracted 93 million views in 24 hours.

headline: Sabrina Carpenter gushes over 'proud' moments of 2026
subheadline: Sabrina Carpenter lists milestone achievements from the year 2026
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Sabrina Carpenter has had a happening year professionally despite taking time off after a rigorous tour, and shared the highlights in a new interview.

The 27-year-old pop superstar released a song with Madonna, called Bring Your Love, performed at Coachella as a headliner, and won several awards.

Speaking about her favourite moments, the Manchild hitmaker said, "This past year has been pretty surreal. Coachella will always be a standout for me, probably for the rest of my life. I had so much fun creating that show. Also getting to perform onstage this year with Madonna and Stevie Nicks. I’m still processing that."

READ MORE: Sabrina Carpenter shows off fan memorabilia with heartfelt appreciation

The Grammy winner had a surprise performance at the Met Gala this year, where she was joined by Nicks and the two performed Landslide duet.

While fans have been waiting for Carpenter's next album, they are also excited for her acting projects including the Fred Astaire biopic, that has already started filming.

headline: Palace shares update on 'perfect representative of Crown'
subheadline: While the Palace faces storms at home, the beloved Duchess is shining abroad
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The Royal Family has issued a beautiful new update as their beloved Duchess has once again brought love, respect and a real shine to the Crown far beyond the UK.

On Tuesday, November 10, the Palace released Duchess Sophie's latest photos from Bangladesh on the Royal Family's official Instagram account, attracting massive likes and hearts from fans, with one calling the royal the 'perfect representative of the Crown'.

The Duchess of Edinburgh has put in extra effort to highlight the real face of the monarchy with her unwavering spirit, far away from her homeland amid the ongoing crisis within the family and media scrutiny about the former working royals.

READ MORE: Duchess Sophie finds how simple bar of soap is helping women rebuild their lives

While the Palace faces storms at home, Sophie is shining abroad. Not with drama, not with scandals, but with kindness, courage and quiet service.

The Palace wrote: "Her Royal Highness is meeting communities and organisations which demonstrate the strength and breadth of the UK-Bangladesh partnership, and seeing the support being provided to the Rohingya community in Bangladesh."

The photos and heartfelt message from Prince Edward's wife delighted royal fans, who could not stop pouring out their love and admiration for one of the most adored royals.

"Always wonderful to see The Duchess of Edinburgh working with the Women, Peace and Security agenda! HRH is truly wonderful and does a lot, very hardworking," one fan penned in the comments section.

Another wrote: "What a perfect representative of the Crown."While the third one called her "Super Sophie," adding: "Connecting with people to make a real difference."

And that is exactly who Sophie is, not just a Duchess, but a superwoman of kindness, proving once again that the Crown shines brightest when it serves with heart.

READ MORE: Duchess Sophie's surprise appearance with REME members ahead of Remembrance

headline: Rupert Grint says late Alan Rickman was 'so nurturing' on 'Harry Potter' set
subheadline: Alan Rickman passed away from pancreatic cancer in 2016 at the age of 69
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Rupert Grint is remembering his late Harry Potter costar Alan Rickman with great fondness.

Speaking to MTV UK on the red-carpet premiere of his new film, Ebenezer, Grint named Rickman as one of the people who has always “inspired and uplifted” him.

“My childhood — I was so lucky to work with so many great actors. A lot of them we’ve lost now,” Grint, 38, said. “One that always sticks with me was Alan Rickman. He was really special and so nurturing as well.”

READ MORE: Gary Oldman recalls Alan Rickman's sweet tradition on 'Harry Potter' set

The actor added that he and Rickman stayed in touch “way after the films finished.”

Alan passed away from pancreatic cancer in 2016 at the age of 69. He was best known for portraying Severus Snape in the original Harry Potter franchise, and his character was anything but nurturing to Grint’s Ron Weasley.

Now, a new generation of faces is going to define the Harry Potter universe as HBO’s remake hits theatres on Christmas Day 2026. Grint will pass on the torch to Alastair Stout as the ginger-haired, hand-me-down-robes-wearing Weasley, while Paapa Essiedu will play the new Snape.

READ MORE: Rupert Grint to return as Ron Weasley in 'Harry Potter and the Cursed Child'

headline: Pakistan-Sri Lanka second Test moved from Lahore to Rawalpindi
subheadline: Second Test will be played from Nov 17 to 21 at Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium, announces PCB spokesperson
author: Web Desk
article_text:
LAHORE: The second Test of the two-match series between Pakistan and Sri Lanka has been shifted from Lahore to Rawalpindi amid thick smog, the Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) announced on Tuesday.

According to a PCB spokesperson, the second match, originally scheduled to be played at Lahore's Gaddafi Stadium from November 17 to 21, has been relocated due to prevailing weather conditions.

The second Test will be played as scheduled from November 17 to 21 at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium.

The venue change comes after two days of play in the series opener at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium, where Sri Lanka trailed hosts Pakistan by 320 runs.

Put into bat first, Pakistan posted 434-9 in 106.3 overs before declaring, with Tayyab Arif, Mohammad Taha, captain Babar Azam, Saud Shakeel and all-rounder Arafat Minhas scoring half-centuries.

In reply, Sri Lanka had reached 114-3 in 27.1 overs before bad light forced an early close for the second consecutive day.

headline: Should elephants have human rights? US court weighs freedom for two zoo animals
subheadline: NGO working on behalf of the animals have filed a habeas corpus writ
author: Web Desk
article_text:
Two elephants kept at a zoo in Hawaii could become the first in the U.S. to win legal recognition of their right to freedom, as the state’s highest court considers whether animals can challenge their captivity under laws traditionally reserved for humans.

The Hawaii Supreme Court heard arguments on Monday in a case involving Mari and Vaigai, two Asian elephants aged 51 and 40, who have spent decades in Honolulu Zoo.

An animal rights organisation named Nonhuman Rights Project has asked for the animals to be shifted to a sanctuary. The organisation officials argue that the elephants’ intelligence, self-awareness and ability to make independent decisions entitle them to legal protection.

The legal team of the NGO working on behalf of the animals have filed a habeas corpus writ, a legal procedure generally used by people challenging unlawful detention.

However, Honolulu authorities oppose the petition saying that such protection to animals would fundamentally change existing law.

During the hearing, Justice Sabrina McKenna questioned whether recognising elephants' rights could open the door to similar claims involving octopuses, reptiles and other animals.

Another judge, Todd Eddins, even raised the possibility of intelligent aliens seeking legal protection, referring to a character from The Flintstones.

The zoo, meanwhile, maintains that the elephants receive proper care and have access to swimming pools, veterinary attention and dedicated keepers.

The case has already been rejected by two lower courts, which ruled that elephants do not qualify as legal persons under Hawaii's habeas corpus laws.

A favourable Supreme Court ruling would not immediately free Mari and Vaigai. Instead, it would allow a further hearing to determine whether their confinement is unlawful.

The court has not announced when it will deliver its decision.

headline: UNFCCC COP31 begins in Türkiye's Antalya: Here's everything to know
subheadline: Nearly 200 countries gather in Antalya for COP31 climate talks
author: Web Desk
article_text:
The 31st Conference of the Parties (COP31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change commenced on Monday in Antalya, Türkiye, as 195 countries convene for two weeks of talks from November 9 to 20, 2026.

Türkiye is the COP31 host country, with its Environment Minister Murat Kurum presiding over the conference.

Australia's Climate Change and Energy Minister Chris Bowen was appointed by consensus at COP30 to be President of Negotiations.

More than 90,000 individuals are set to participate in the talks in Antalya, from heads of state, negotiators, business leaders, to scientists and civil society representatives.

COP31 organisers have characterised this year's summit as a “COP of implementation”, focused on making commitments happen as opposed to making sweeping new statements. Simon Stiell, the head of UN Climate Change, addressed the plenary session of COP31, saying, "Progress is not nearly enough or fair enough."

There are three main tracks: emissions, where countries will make good on their stronger Nationally Determined Contributions under the Paris Agreement; finance, which involves fulfilling the new collective quantified finance goal agreed to at COP29; and adaptation and resilience for vulnerable countries. The financing track is expected to be the most difficult, with developing countries demanding faster access to finance.

The Presidency’s Action Agenda includes a global electrification goal of “35 by 2035.” The International Energy Agency estimates that electricity could provide 33 percent of the world’s final energy consumption by 2035 (just shy of the goal), up from 23 percent today.

Monday was Food, Agriculture and Health Day, focusing on climate effects on human health against the backdrop of an impending El Niño with extreme weather effects. Negotiators will also discuss fossil fuels language, which producers such as Saudi Arabia and Russia will oppose once again.

The United States is not sending a delegation, continuing the Trump administration's withdrawal from climate diplomacy. Some Democratic lawmakers, including Senator Sheldon Whitehouse, are attending independently.
